# Nama ERP Documentation

> User and support documentation for Nama ERP. Every page listed here has an Arabic mirror at
> the same path under /ar - https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounts.html is
> https://docs.namasoft.com/ar/modules/accounting/accounts.html in Arabic. The database schema
> (tables, columns, enums) is a separate site: https://dm.namasoft.com

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/): New to Nama ERP? Start here.
- [What is Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/what-is-nama-erp.html): If you have just been handed a login and told to support Nama ERP, the honest first problem is not that the system is complicated — it is that nobody tells you the handful of ideas the whole thing is...
- [Glossary of Nama ERP Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/nama-erp-glossary.html): Nama ERP is used in Arabic and in English, often by the same team on the same call.
- [System Minimum Requirements](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/system-minimum-requirements.html): Nama ERP is a web-based application, It can be hosted on-premise or on-cloud
- [Nama ERP Installation Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/installation-guide.html): Nama ERP is a Java-based web application that runs on Apache Tomcat and uses Microsoft SQL Server as its default database engine.
- [Nama Properties](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/nama-properties.html): serverid=AnyIDYouWant
- [Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/two-factor-authentication.html): Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to the Nama ERP login process by requiring users to provide a second form of verification beyond their username and password.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/): Sooner or later someone in your IT department will ask the question that no feature list answers: what is this thing, exactly, and what will it do to our servers? Perhaps a security review board wants...
- [Application Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/application-architecture.html): Nama ERP is a single Java web application.
- [Infrastructure Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/infrastructure-architecture.html): This page answers the question a systems administrator actually needs answered: what has to be built, opened, backed up and watched in order to run Nama ERP.
- [Security Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/security-architecture.html): Security questions arrive in a predictable order.

## Platform Features

- [Platform Features](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/): Every Nama ERP module — accounting, supply chain, HR — is built on the same platform.
- [Buttons on Every Screen](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-buttons.html): Nama has hundreds of screens, and almost none of them have their own buttons.
- [Remarks, Agenda and Work Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/remarks-and-agenda.html): Sooner or later somebody needs to write something down against a record. - entities: Remark, DetailedRemark, MeetingRemark, WorkTask, EmployeeAgenda, RemarkType
- [Default Values Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/default-values-templates.html): Most data entry is repetition. - entities: DefaultValuesTemplate - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Default Values Template
- [Preventing a Record From Being Used](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/prevent-usage.html): An item is withdrawn from the catalogue.
- [Document Books](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/document-books.html): Every document in Nama — every sales invoice, stock issue, receipt voucher, journal entry — has to belong to a document book. - entities: DocumentBook - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Book
- [Document Cancel Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/document-cancel-document.html): Sooner or later somebody commits a document they should not have. - entities: DocumentCancelDocument - menu: Basic → Documents → Document Cancel Document
- [Master Groups](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/master-groups.html): Document books number documents. - entities: MasterGroup - menu: Basic → Settings → Group
- [Audit Trail and Version History](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/audit-trail.html): Sooner or later somebody asks the question every ERP has to answer: who changed this, and what did it say before? A customer's credit limit is suddenly double what it was. - entities: ActionsHistory, EntityVersion, FieldDetailedAudit
- [Attachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/attachments.html): Paperwork follows business documents around. - entities: AttachmentInfo

### Global Configuration

- [Global Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/): Almost every other configuration file in Nama belongs to one module — supply chain settings shape inventory, HR settings shape payroll.
- [General](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-general.html): The General tab holds the settings that don't belong to any one business area but shape how numbers, dates and text look everywhere: what the second interface language is, how many decimal places a... - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Dimensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-dimensions.html): Dimensions are how Nama answers "which part of the business does this record belong to?". - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Documents and Books](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-documents.html): Every document in Nama gets its number from a book and its behaviour from a document term. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Taxes and e-Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-taxes.html): Nama carries four independent taxes on every document line. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-discounts.html): A document line in Nama can carry up to eight separate discounts plus one discount at the document header. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Accounting and Finance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-accounting.html): This tab collects the settings that decide when a difference is small enough to ignore, how many account slots a customer or supplier carries, how credit limits and debt ages are tracked, and how... - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Customers and Sales](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-sales.html): A short tab with three unrelated jobs: deciding who counts as the salesman on a document, how customer codes are formed, and how this installation talks to Nama CRM. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Approvals and Revise](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-approvals.html): Nama has two separate ways of putting a human check between "someone entered this" and "the system acted on it". - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Security and Login](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-security.html): Everything about getting into the system and what you can see once you are in: login attempts and sessions, password rules, two-factor authentication, LDAP, record-level visibility, and the public... - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Performance and Search](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-performance.html): Two related concerns live on this tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Appearance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-appearance.html): How the system looks and how users move around it: what opens at startup, what the login page shows, which fonts and colours are used, and how popups and tooltips behave. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Entities Screens](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-entity-screens.html): This tab is unusual: nothing on it changes how the system behaves. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Notifications and Messaging](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-notifications.html): Everything the system needs in order to tell someone something: in-app notifications and their sounds, and the email and SMS accounts it sends through. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Reports and Printing](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-reports.html): Everything about producing output: the format a report opens in, what appears on the printed page, how dimension parameters are filled, what is logged, how values are formatted, and how Excel exports... - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Attachments and Storage](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-attachments.html): Where attached files live, how their disk space is watched, and the two external tools the system uses to scan paper and convert documents. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Replication](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-replication.html): Replication keeps several Nama sites in step — a head office and its branches, or servers in different countries. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Currencies Tafqeet](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-currencies.html): Tafqeet is writing an amount in words — the line on a cheque or an invoice that reads "One thousand two hundred Egyptian Pounds and fifty Piasters only". - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Utility Links](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/utils.html): ::: danger This file contains potentially dangerous links.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shortcuts.html): These are global shortcuts (handled anywhere in the app) intended for support staff and developers.

### Screen Modifier

- [Screen Modifier](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/)
- [Screen Modifier — Overview & Concepts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-overview.html): Every screen in Nama ERP — the edit screen of an invoice, the list view of customers, the pop-up you use to pick an item — ships with a default design. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Screen Modifier — Edit-Screen Modifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-edit-screen.html): This page covers everything you can change about an edit screen — the screen a user opens to view or enter a single record. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Screen Modifier — List View & Selector Pop-up](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-list-and-search.html): Besides edit screens, a Screen Modifier can reshape the two places where records are listed: - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Screen Modifier — Visual Layout Editor](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-visual-editor.html): Filling in dozens of collections by hand is precise, but slow. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Screen Modifier — Frequently Asked Questions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-faq.html): Saving a Screen Modifier records your instructions — it does not rebuild the screens. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier

### The Menu

- [The Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/): The tree down the side of the screen is not fixed.
- [How the Menu Is Put Together](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/menu-structure.html): The menu down the side of the screen looks like a tree, so people expect to edit it like one — drag a folder here, drop an entry there. - entities: MenuDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Menu Definition
- [Changing the Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/menu-update.html): Sooner or later somebody asks for the menu to be rearranged. - entities: MenuModifier, MenuDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Menu Update
- [Who Sees Which Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/menu-visibility.html): Two people sign in to the same system and see different menus. - entities: MenuDefinition

### Fields and Entities Settings

- [Fields and Entities Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/): Every organisation wants the system to behave slightly differently.
- [Fields and Entities Settings — How It Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-overview.html): A company goes live and asks for three things in the first week. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Field Appearance and Input Widgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-field-appearance.html): A number is a number and a piece of text is a piece of text — but 1250000 and 1,250,000 are very different things to read at a glance, and a mobile number you can tap to dial saves a user from copying... - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Icons and Colours](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-field-icons.html): Nama already ships an icon and a colour for most entity types and for the status values people meet every day, so a user recognises a Sales Invoice, a Customer or an "Approved" status at a glance... - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Input Rules and Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-input-validation.html): Every organisation ends up with rules about what may go into a field. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Reference Fields and Lookups](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-reference-lookups.html): A reference field is any field that points at another record: the customer on a Sales Invoice, the item on an invoice line, the warehouse on a Stock Issue. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Calculated Fields and Row Colouring](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-calculated-fields.html): Sometimes the information a user needs is not stored on the record in front of them. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Automatic Coding of Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-auto-coding.html): Master files need codes. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Lifting Built-in Restrictions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-relaxing-restrictions.html): Almost everything on the Fields and Entities Settings screen adds a rule: a mask that formats a number, a validation that refuses bad input, a formula that fills a field in for you. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Record Behaviour and Screen Blocks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-record-behaviour.html): Most of the Fields and Entities Settings screen is about a single field — how it is drawn, what may be typed into it, where its list of choices comes from. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Integrators and Public Links](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-integrations.html): Almost everything on this screen changes how Nama behaves for people who are already signed in. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings

### List Views

- [List Views](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/): List views are the screens where you browse and search your records — and where you act on them in numbers.
- [Quick Filters in List Views](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/quick-filters.html): ::: tip New Feature Quick Filters have been developed to enhance user experience in filtering data quickly and intuitively across all list views in Nama ERP system. - entities: ScreenModifier, QuickFilterCriteria
- [Limit User To Year](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/limit-user-to-year.html): This feature lets you restrict users' access to specific fiscal years and accounting periods, preventing them from viewing or creating documents in fiscal years they are not authorized to work with. - entities: LimitUserToYear - menu: Administration → Security → Limit User To Year
- [Acting on Several Records at Once](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/mass-operations.html): A list screen does more than show you records.
- [Bulk Edit](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/bulk-edit.html): Someone has to move four hundred customers onto a new salesman. - entities: BulkEditConfig, ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Bulk Edit Config
- [Fiscal Period Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fiscal-period-control-guide.html): In many organizations, simply marking an accounting period as "open" or "closed" for everyone is not enough. - entities: FiscalYearStatusUpdate, FiscalYear

### Approvals

- [Approvals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/): Some documents shouldn't go through without a sign-off — a large purchase order, a stock transfer, a discount above a threshold.
- [Approvals System - Approval Definition Full Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/approvals-system.html): The Nama ERP Approvals System provides a comprehensive workflow management solution that allows organizations to define approval processes for various business operations. - entities: ApprovalDefinition, ApprovalCase - menu: Basic → Settings → Approval Definition
- [Sample Approval Email Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/sample-approval-email-templates.html): When a document enters an approval workflow, NAMA can send the responsible person an email asking them to approve, reject, or return it. - entities: ApprovalDefinition - menu: Basic → Settings → Approval Definition
- [Approvals FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/approvals-faq.html): If you have multiple warehouses, each with a different warehouse keeper and direct supervisor, and you want the approval of a stock transfer to be the responsibility of the warehouse that will receive... - entities: ApprovalDefinition - menu: Basic → Settings → Approval Definition
- [Revise and Unrevise](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/revise-and-unrevise.html): Every business has records that someone other than the person who entered them is supposed to look at. - entities: RevisionDoc, DetailedRevisionConfig, RevisionCase

### Security & Permissions

- [Security & Permissions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/): Every ERP deployment runs into the same questions sooner or later: who can log in, who can see customer balances, and why does a Jeddah rep see Riyadh invoices? Nama answers all of these with a...
- [Security System Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/security-overview.html): Every ERP deployment faces the same questions sooner or later: who is allowed to view customer balances? Can the warehouse keeper delete a saved stock issue? And why does a Jeddah branch sales rep see...
- [Security Profile](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/security-profiles.html): The Security Profile is where most of your permission settings live. - entities: SecurityProfile - menu: Administration → Security → Security Profile
- [Field, Page, and List View Security](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/field-page-listview-security.html): Basic permissions answer the question "what can the user do with a type?" But you often need finer control: hide the Cost column from sales reps, lock the System Entries page for data-entry operators,... - entities: SecurityProfile, NaMaUser
- [Record-Level Security (Dimensions and Filters)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/record-level-security.html): Granting a user list view access to sales invoices answers the question "can they browse invoices?" This page answers the follow-up: which invoices specifically? Nama narrows record visibility through... - entities: NaMaUser, SecurityProfile
- [Users and Login](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/users-and-login.html): The User record is where identity, authentication, and personal permission overrides converge. - entities: NaMaUser - menu: Administration → Security → User
- [Temporary Additional Permissions (Delegation)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/security-delegation.html): The purchasing manager is on two weeks' leave, and purchase order approvals must keep flowing. - entities: SecurityProfileTransfer - menu: Administration → Security → Security Profile Transfer

### Importing & Exporting Records

- [Importing & Exporting Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/): Almost every implementation starts the same way: the customer has years of data sitting in spreadsheets, and it needs to end up in the system.
- [Exporting Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/exporting-records.html): Every list screen in Nama can hand you its records as a file.
- [Importing Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/importing-records.html): Importing is the mirror image of exporting: you hand the system a workbook, and it creates or updates records from it.
- [Anatomy of the Export File](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/export-file-format.html): The first time you open an exported workbook you will wonder what happened to it.
- [Files Export / Import Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/files-export-import-menu.html): The export dialog is fine for a one-off. - entities: FilesExportMenu - menu: Basic → Settings → Files Export / Import Menu
- [Advanced Record Import](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/advanced-record-import.html): The ordinary Import Records command has one requirement that quietly rules out half of real-world data loading: the file must be in Nama's own layout. - entities: RecordImportConfig, RecordImportList, RecordImportDoc

### Document Management

- [Document Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/): Every business keeps paper it cannot throw away: signed contracts, commercial registrations, title deeds, copies of national IDs.
- [Document Management Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-overview.html): Most of what an ERP stores is data you typed.
- [Archives, Folders and Topics](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-filing-structure.html): Three master files describe where paperwork lives and what it is about. - entities: DMSLocation, DMSFolder, DMSTopic
- [Archived Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-documents.html): The DMS Document is the record everything else in this section exists to support. - entities: DMSDocument - menu: Basic → Document Management System → DMS Document
- [Checking Documents In and Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-movements.html): Paper leaves the archive. - entities: DMSDocMovement, DMSFolderMovement - menu: Basic → Document Management System → Document Movement
- [Loading an Archive from a ZIP File](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-bulk-import.html): Registering documents one at a time is fine for the trickle of new paperwork. - entities: DMSCompressedFileToDocs - menu: Basic → Document Management System → Compressed File To DMS Document
- [Settings and Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-configuration.html): Document Management has only three settings of its own.

### Entity Flows

- [Entity Flows](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/): Entity Flows let you automate the system's reaction to everyday actions — saving, editing, revising a record — without writing any code.
- [Introduction to Entity Flows](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/introduction-to-entity-flows.html): Entity Flows are one of the most powerful features in Nama ERP. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Importing Data from Excel or Queries](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/excel-and-sql-import-by-entity-flow.html): Nama ERP allows you to import data directly from Excel sheets. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Creating Records Automatically While Saving](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/ea-gen-entity-from-entity.html): The primary purpose of this element is to create records while saving other records. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Entity Flow Examples](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-examples.html): Create an Entity Flow with the action "Manual" of type EAFieldsValuesCalculator and place it in the edit screen. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Entity Flow FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-faq.html): I set the required type in Fields and Entities Settings, but the value is not saved. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow

### Reports and Printed Forms

- [Reports and Printed Forms](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/): Reports are how you get your data back out of Nama ERP, and printed forms are how a single document reaches paper.
- [Jasper Reports Complete Guide for Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/reports-guide.html): Every report and every printed form that Nama ERP produces is a JasperReports design: a layout file with a SQL query behind it and a set of prompts in front of it. - entities: ReportDefinition - menu: Reports → Reports Monitoring → Report Definition
- [Report and Form Wizards](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-and-form-wizards.html): Nama has two wizards. - entities: ReportWizard, PrintingFormWizard
- [Report Wizard Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-wizard-guide.html): Nama ERP provides an easy and effective way to create professional reports quickly using the Report Wizard tool. - entities: ReportWizard - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Wizard
- [Printing Form Wizard](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printing-form-wizard-guide.html): Every business eventually needs its own invoice. - entities: PrintingFormWizard - menu: Administration → Reports → Printing Form Wizard
- [Which Printed Form Comes Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printed-form-selection.html): Press Print on a sales invoice and nothing is asked of you. - entities: ReportDefinition - menu: Reports → Reports Monitoring → Report Definition
- [Report Styles](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-styles.html): Building a report or a printed form with a wizard means placing dozens of fields, and every one of them needs a colour, a font, an alignment and a border. - entities: ReportStyle - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Style
- [Custom Report Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/custom-report-menu.html): A user is looking at a sales invoice on screen. - entities: CustomReportMenu - menu: Administration → Reports → Custom Report Menu
- [NamaRep Expression Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/reports-namarep-reference.html): Inside a report, anywhere JasperReports accepts an expression — a text field, a variable, a parameter default, a print-when condition — you can call NamaRep.

### Business Intelligence

- [Business Intelligence](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/): The BI module turns your live ERP data into interactive dashboards — charts, gauges, tables, and cards that talk to each other through cross-filters, drill-downs, and direct links.
- [BI Module — Dashboards & Analytics](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-module-guide.html): Nama ERP's BI module lets you build interactive dashboards that turn your live ERP data into charts, gauges, tables, and more. - entities: DashBoardWidget, DashBoard, BICrossFilter, DashBoardWidgetWizard, BIPeriodComparisonConfig
- [Nama ERP BI Module — Technical Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-module-technical-reference.html): This document is the authoritative technical reference for the Nama ERP BI (Business Intelligence) module's JSON structures. - entities: DashBoardWidget, BICrossFilter, DashBoard, DashBoardWidgetWizard
- [BI Reference — EnhancedMetricsCard (and legacy MetricsCards)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-enhanced-metrics-card.html): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidget - menu: Administration → DashBoards → DashBoard Widget
- [BI Reference — EnhancedTable](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-enhanced-table.html): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidget - menu: Administration → DashBoards → DashBoard Widget
- [BI Reference — Wizard Mode](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-wizard-mode.html): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidgetWizard, DashBoardWidget

### Notifications

- [Notifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/): When something important happens in the system — a new invoice, an approval request, a processing error — the right person should hear about it without anyone remembering to tell them.
- [Nama ERP Notification System](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/notifications-system.html): The Nama ERP notification system is a comprehensive communication platform that automatically sends notifications to users when specific business events occur. - entities: NotificationDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Notification Definition
- [SMS and WhatsApp Configuration in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/sms-and-whatsapp.html): Nama ERP supports sending messages via SMS and WhatsApp to users, customers, suppliers, and other entities. - entities: WhatsAppMessageConfiguration
- [Frequently Asked Questions: Notifications and Messages](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/notification-fq.html): When posting a receipt that contains multiple lines for multiple customers, you may notice that the notification is sent only to the first customer and not to the remaining customers in the other... - entities: NotificationDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Notification Definition
- [Virtual Entities — Reusable SQL Building Blocks for Reports & Dashboards](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/virtual-entity-guide.html): You've probably been here before: the same complex SQL query keeps showing up in five different report-wizard records and three dashboard widgets. - entities: VirtualEntity - menu: Administration → Reports → Virtual Entity
- [Field Filter with Criteria](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filter-with-criteria.html): You can use the Field Filter with Criteria screen to apply custom filters when searching within specific fields on any Nama ERP screen. - entities: UserFieldFilter - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Field Filter With Criteria
- [Frequently Asked Questions about Field Filtering](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filter-faq.html): I am using Reference 1 in the item inventory to fetch items, and I want it to show only the same items that were selected in the details.
- [Modifying Translations in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/translations.html): To modify these translations: - entities: TranslationOverRider - menu: Basic → Settings → Translation OverRider
- [Criteria Based Validation](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/criteria-based-validation.html): Every business has rules that the standard screens know nothing about. - entities: CriteriaBasedValidator - menu: Basic → Settings → Criteria Based Validator
- [Criteria from Text Parser (Text Criteria Guide)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/text-criteria-guide.html): Nama ERP provides a flexible text-based filtering mechanism that allows users to define filter criteria using a simple, structured format.
- [Scheduled Tasks (Task Scheduler)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/scheduled-tasks.html): Task Scheduler lets you automate recurring operations in Nama ERP. - entities: TaskSchedule - menu: Basic → Settings → Task Schedule

### Background Processing

- [Background Processing](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/): Nama does a great deal of work behind you.
- [Business Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/business-requests.html): When you save an invoice, the accounting entry behind it is not written while you wait. - entities: BusinessRequestStatus, SavedBusinessRequest - menu: Administration → Settings → Business Requests
- [Pending Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/pending-tasks.html): Despite the general-sounding name, this screen is one specific thing: the outbox. - entities: PendingTask - menu: Administration → Settings → Pending Tasks
- [System Actions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/system-actions.html): Two screens sit next to each other in the menu with almost the same name, and they have nothing to do with one another. - entities: PendingSystemAction, AutoSystemAction
- [Report Monitoring](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/report-monitoring.html): A report that takes thirty seconds and a report that has hung look identical from the outside — a spinner, and a user asking whether to keep waiting. - entities: ReportLog
- [Task Queues](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/task-queues.html): Nama has always done its slow work behind you rather than while you wait. - entities: TaskQueue, EntityFlow, TaskSchedule - menu: Basic → Settings → Task Queue
- [Recurring Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/recurring-documents.html): Some documents come back on a rhythm. - entities: RecuringDocument - menu: Basic → Documents → Recuring Document

### Invoicing, Taxes & Discounts

- [Invoicing, Taxes & Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/): Invoicing is where a sale turns into money owed — and into a tax-compliant document that both your customer and your government will accept.

- [Invoice Discounts and Tax Calculation System - Comprehensive Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/invoice-discounts-and-tax-calculation-guide.html): Nama ERP provides a sophisticated invoice discount and tax calculation system that supports complex business requirements. - entities: TaxPlan, TaxDiscountEffectsConfig - menu: Basic → Master Files → Tax Plan
- [Pricing and Offers Management Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/pricing-and-offers-guide.html): This comprehensive guide covers the pricing system in Nama ERP, including price lists, sales offers, and automated pricing mechanisms that help maintain accurate and competitive pricing throughout... - entities: SalesPriceList, SalesOffers - menu: Sales → Prices And Offers → Price List
- [Payment Schedules User Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/payment-schedules-user-guide.html): The Payment Schedules feature in Nama ERP allows you to define flexible payment terms and installment plans for sales documents. - entities: PaymentScheduleTemplate, ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher - menu: Purchases → Master Files → Payment Schedule Template
- [Linking Payment Vouchers to Invoices](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/payment-entries.html): Nama ERP supports linking invoices to payment vouchers flexibly across multiple scenarios. - entities: ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher
- [Online Payments Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/online-payments.html): Nama ERP's online payment module lets you accept payments directly from your customers through secure payment gateways. - entities: OnlinePaymentConfig, PaymentLinksCreationDoc - menu: Basic → Documents → Online Payment Configuration
- [Electronic Invoicing in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/e-invoices-guide.html): Most tax authorities no longer accept a printed invoice as the record of a sale. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Integration with ZATCA (Saudi Arabia – Fatoora)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/zatca-guide.html): The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) requires VAT-registered businesses in Saudi Arabia to issue their invoices electronically and integrate with the Fatoora e-invoicing platform. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration

- [Bank Details on Egyptian e-Invoices](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/egypt-einvoice-bank-details.html): An Egyptian e-invoice can optionally tell the buyer where to send the money — the bank, the account number, the IBAN and your payment terms. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, Bank, BankAccount - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [UAE E-Invoicing Integration via Orchida osTax](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/uae-orchida-einvoice-guide.html): NamaERP supports sending electronic invoices to the UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) through the Orchida osTax service provider. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Standard Terms and Conditions Feature Documentation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/standard-terms-feature-documentation.html): The Standard Terms feature in Nama ERP provides a comprehensive mechanism for tracking terms and conditions in sales documents (invoices, quotations, etc.) and monitoring whether these terms have been... - entities: SalesStandardTerm, StandardTermFulfillment, StandardTermExtension - menu: Basic → Master Files → Sales Standard Term
- [Barcode Field Feature for Sequential Scanning](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/barcode-field-feature.html): A new feature has been developed in Nama ERP to solve the problem of losing focus when scanning item barcodes in browsers.

### Accounting & Banks

- [Accounting & Banks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/): The NaMa Accounting System is the financial engine of the whole product: every document in Nama — a sales invoice, a stock issue, a payroll run, an asset depreciation — ultimately lands as an...
- [Accounting Concepts & First-Time Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounting-concepts-and-setup.html): Before you can record your first entry, the accounting system needs to "know" a few fixed facts about your organization: What is your main currency? Which chart of accounts do you work on? What is... - entities: Ledger, AccountChartType, AccountingCalendar, FiscalYear - menu: Accounting → Settings → Ledger
- [Chart of Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/chart-of-accounts.html): The chart of accounts is the backbone of your accounting system: a hierarchical structure that classifies everything you own, owe, earn, and spend into logical, branching groups. - entities: AccountsChart, AccountCategory, AccountTaxCategory - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Accounts Chart
- [Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounts.html): If the chart of accounts is the structure, the Account is the unit balances are actually recorded on. - entities: Account - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Account
- [Journal Entries & Adjustments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/journal-entries.html): Most entries in Nama are generated automatically from other documents (an invoice, a stock issue, a payroll run...), but there's always a need to record manual entries: an adjustment, a petty expense,... - entities: JournalEntry, CurrencyDiffJournal, ExchangeRateUpdate, InterCompanyTransfer - menu: Accounting → Documents → Journal Entry
- [Year-End Closing & Period Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/year-end-and-period-control.html): At the end of each fiscal year comes the moment of closing: carrying the year's profit/loss into equity, and closing the result accounts in preparation for a new year. - entities: ClosingEntry, PreventAccTransactions, LedgerReviseDoc, PurgeJournal - menu: Accounting → Documents → Closing Entry
- [Receipt & Payment Vouchers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/receipts-and-payments.html): Every bit of money that enters or leaves your safe or bank passes through this family of documents. - entities: ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher, ReceiptOrder, PaymentOrder, RVRequest, PVRequest, ConsolidatedRVRequest, ConsolidatedPVRequest - menu: Accounting → Documents → Receipt Voucher
- [Credit & Debit Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-and-debit-notes.html): Sometimes you need to adjust a customer's or supplier's balance without any cash receipt or payment: a settlement discount for a customer, a sales return, or an extra charge on a supplier. - entities: CreditNote, DebitNote - menu: Accounting → Documents → CreditNote
- [Aging Allocation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/aging-allocation.html): A debt-age report answers one question: how old is this balance? To answer it the system has to know which receipt paid which invoice — not just that a customer owes 40,000 and has paid 25,000, but... - entities: AgingAllocation - menu: Banks → Master Files → Aging Allocation
- [Cashier Shifts (Cash Drawer)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cashier-shifts.html): The general receipt and payment vouchers (see their page) are flexible but more detailed than a cashier needs when handling dozens of quick payments a day. - entities: CSHOpenShift, CSHCloseShift, CSHReceiptVoucher, CSHPaymentVoucher, ElectronicReceiptVoucher - menu: Accounting → Cashiers → Open Shift
- [Banks, Bank Accounts & Transfers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/banks-and-bank-accounts.html): Managing the banking side starts by defining the banks you deal with, then the bank accounts opened with them. - entities: Bank, BankAccount, BankTransfer, BankAdjustment - menu: Banks → Master Files → Bank
- [Bank Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-reconciliation.html): Your bank balance in your books rarely matches the bank statement moment for moment: a cheque you deposited isn't yet collected, a fee the bank deducted you haven't recorded yet, a transfer in... - entities: BankReconciliation - menu: Banks → Cheques → Bank Reconciliation
- [Cheques & Financial Papers (Lifecycle)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cheques-financial-papers.html): A cheque isn't just an amount; it's a paper with a journey: it's received, deposited at the bank, collected or returned, and may be endorsed to another party or discounted before its due date. - entities: FinancialPaper, FPBook, BankPortfolio, BankNotice, OpenningFinancialPaper, FinancialPaperAgio, FinancialPaperCancel, FPTransfer - menu: Banks → Master Files → Commercial Paper
- [Bank Loans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-loans.html): A bank loan isn't just an amount that lands in your account and then gets repaid; it's a commitment that stretches over months or years, with a principal, interest, fees and an installment schedule —... - entities: BankLoan, BankLoanRequest, LoanIssue, LoanInstallmentPayment, LoanInterestsCalculation, BankLoanScheduling, BankLoanChangingDoc, BankLoanType - menu: Banks → Bank Loans → Bank Loan
- [Fixed Deposits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/fixed-deposits.html): A fixed deposit is the mirror image of a loan: instead of borrowing from the bank, you place an amount with it for a set term in return for interest. - entities: FixedDeposit, FixedDepositIssue, InterestPaymentDocument, FixedDepositChangingDoc - menu: Banks → Fixed Deposits → Fixed Deposit
- [Credit Facilities & Facility Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-facilities.html): Two related but distinct ideas meet on this page: - entities: CreditFacility, FacilityLimit, FacilityLimitConfig, CreditFacilitySetting, CreditFacilityIssuance, CreditFacilityPayment, CreditFacilityTermination - menu: Banks → Credit Facilities → Credit Facility
- [Letters of Guarantee](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/letters-of-guarantee.html): A letter of guarantee is an undertaking the bank issues on your behalf in favor of a third party (a government body, a project owner…) guaranteeing that you'll meet some obligation — like a... - entities: LetterOfGuarantee, LGTIssue, LGTReceipt, LGTDelivery, LGTChanging, LGTClosing, LGTReq - menu: Banks → Letters Of Guarantee → Letter Of Guarantee
- [Bank Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-letters-of-credit.html): A letter of credit (LC) is a tool an importer uses to reassure the supplier: the bank undertakes to pay the supplier the shipment's value once they present shipping documents matching the terms. - entities: BankLC, BLCOpeningDoc, BLCChanging, BLCClosingDoc, BLCReq - menu: Banks → Bank LC → Bank LC
- [Treasury Bills](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/treasury-bills.html): A treasury bill is a short-term investment instrument the state issues: you buy it for less than its nominal value, and at maturity you collect its full value, so the difference is your return. - entities: TreasuryBill, TreasuryBillPurchaseDoc, TrasureyBillROIProofDoc, AggTreasuryBillProofDoc, TreasuryBillSalesDoc, TreasuryBillCloseDoc - menu: Banks → Treasury Bill → Treasury Bill
- [Investment Portfolios](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-portfolios.html): When a company puts money into ventures — a stake in another business, a project, a managed fund — it needs to track each investment as an asset in its own right: how much capital went in, what it's... - entities: IPInvestmentPortfolio, IPInvestmentStart, IPInvestmentEnd, IPInvestmentUpdate, IPInvestmentProfitDistribution, IPInvestmentIncreaseCapital, IPInvestmentOpportunity, Investor, InvestmentProject - menu: Accounting → Investment Portfolios → Investment Portfolio
- [Investment Documents & Fund Certificates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-documents.html): Beyond the portfolio system that tracks investment assets, Nama has a second investment world for the paper instruments a company buys and holds: bonds and fund certificates. - entities: InvestmentDoc, InvestmentDocumentFund, InvestmentDocPurchase, InvestmentDocROIProof, AggregatedInvestmentDocROIProof, InvestmentDocClaiming, InvestmentDocumentPurchase, InvestmentDocumentSale, InvestmentDocumentPriceUpdate, ProfitDistributationDoc - menu: Banks → Investment Documents → Investment Document
- [Prepaid Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/prepaid-expenses.html): Some expenses are paid once but belong to many months: an annual rent paid up front, a yearly insurance premium, a maintenance contract. - entities: PrepaidExpenseContract, PrepaidExpenseItem, PrepaidExpenseLedger - menu: Accounting → Prepaid Expense Contracts → Prepaid Expense Contract
- [Financial Commitments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-commitments.html): A company carries many recurring obligations that aren't invoices yet but are very real: a yearly rent paid in quarterly installments, an insurance policy, a financing agreement with a fixed repayment... - entities: FinancialCommitment, FinancialCommitmentPayDoc, FinancialCommitmentReschedule, FinancialCommitmentCategory - menu: Accounting → Financial Commitment Management → Financial Commitment
- [Financial Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-budgets.html): A budget is a plan with teeth: you decide up front how much each account may spend (or should earn) over a period, and then — if you want — the system holds your documents to that plan, warning or... - entities: FinancialBudget, BudgetScenario - menu: BUDGETS → Budgets → Financial Budget
- [Financial Statements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-statements.html): Every company needs an income statement and a balance sheet, but no two companies want them laid out exactly the same way — different line groupings, different subtotals, different comparison columns. - entities: FSSettingsFile, FSIssueFile, FSAccountGroup, FSEquation - menu: Accounting → Financial Statement → FS Settings File
- [Misc Purchasing & Machine Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/misc-purchasing.html): Not every purchase flows through the inventory module. - entities: MiscPurchaseInvoice, MiscPurchaseReq, MiscPurchaseOrder, PurchaseElement, MachineRentInvoice - menu: Accounting → Documents → Miscellaneous Invoice
- [Party Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/party-evaluation.html): Numbers tell you what a supplier charged or what a customer paid, but not whether they're good to work with: Did the supplier deliver on time? Is the bank responsive? Is the customer reliable? Party... - entities: PartyEvaluation, PartyEvaluationElement, PartyEvalElementGroup - menu: Accounting → Party Evaluations → Party Evaluation
- [Subsidiary Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/subsidiary-reconciliation.html): A customer or supplier almost always keeps their own account of your dealings — and it rarely lines up with yours to the penny: an invoice they haven't booked, a payment in transit, a credit note one... - entities: SubsidiaryReconciliation - menu: Accounting → Reconciliations → Subsidiary Reconciliation
- [Account Statements, Trial Balance & Analysis](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/reports-account-statements-and-trial-balance.html): Once transactions are recorded, the moment of questions arrives: What is this account's balance? What moved on this customer's subsidiary? Are my books balanced? The account reports family (SYSR-ACC)...

### Supply Chain

- [Supply Chain](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/): Welcome to the Supply Chain Management module - the heart of how NaMa ERP helps you track, manage, and control the flow of goods through your organization.
- [Understanding Inventory Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/understanding-items.html): Let's talk about Items - the building blocks of the entire supply chain system. - entities: InvItem - menu: Inventory → Master Files → Item
- [Warehouses & Locators](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/warehouses-and-locators.html): You've defined your items - great. - entities: Warehouse, Locator, WarehouseUsagePolicy, WarehouseGroup, WareLocationClass, ItemWarehouseRelation - menu: Inventory → Master Files → Warehouse
- [Receiving Stock](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/receiving-stock.html): Inventory doesn't magically appear in your warehouse - it arrives through various means and for various reasons. - entities: StockReceipt, StockReceiptReq, InitialReceipt, PurgeStockReceipt, ReceiptInspection, StockReceiptCancellation, OpeningStockDocument - menu: Inventory → Receipt Documents → Stock Receipt
- [Issuing Stock](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/issuing-stock.html): What goes in must come out! While receiving stock is about bringing items into your warehouse, issuing is about releasing them for use. - entities: StockIssue, StockIssueReq, ItemCuttingDoc - menu: Inventory → Receipt Documents → Stock Issue
- [Moving Stock Between Warehouses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/moving-stock.html): Sometimes items don't come in or go out - they just move from one place to another. - entities: StockTransfer, IssueStockTransfer, ReceiptStockTransfer, StockTransferReq, AggrStockTransferReq - menu: Inventory → Stock transfer Docs → Stock Transfer
- [Stock Taking](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/stock-taking.html): No matter how accurate your system is, one fundamental question remains: does what's in the books actually match what's on the shelves? Stock taking is the process by which you verify that and... - entities: StartStockTaking, EndStockTaking, StockTakingDetails, StockTakingElectronic, ItemVotingDoc, ItemVotingFile
- [Inventory Costing & Revaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/inventory-costing.html): Inventory quantity is only half the truth; the other half is its value. - entities: ReceiptAdditionalCost, CostRevaluation, FinishedProductPricing, FrozenCostAccounts
- [The Purchasing Journey](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchasing-journey.html): Let's follow the complete story of how items get purchased - from "we need something" to "it's in our warehouse and we've paid for it." This journey involves many people, documents, and decisions. - entities: PurchaseOrder, PurchaseInvoice, ItemRequest, PurchaseQuotation, PurchaseQuotationRequest, PurchasePriceComparing, ConsolidatedPurchaseReq, PurchaseReturn, PurchaseReturnReq, ProformaPurchaseInvoice, PurchaseDocumentUpdate
- [Purchase Forecast](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchase-forecast.html): The best purchase is the one made before you run out, not after. - entities: NewPurchaseForecast, PurchaseForecastConfig, PFSalesSourceConfig, PFQuantitySource - menu: Purchases → New Purchase Forecast → New Purchase Forecast
- [The Sales Journey](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/sales-journey.html): The sales journey is the mirror image of purchasing - instead of bringing items in, you're selling and delivering them to customers. - entities: SalesInvoice, SalesOrder, SalesQuotation, SalesQuotationRequest, ProformaSalesInvoice, SalesReturn, SalesReturnRequest, SalesReplacement, SalesForecast
- [Pricing, Offers & Coupons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/pricing-offers-and-coupons.html): The price a customer pays isn't a single number, but the result of several layers: a price list, a quantity discount, a promotional offer, and maybe a coupon. - entities: SalesPriceList, SalesOffers, DiscountCoupon, PostSalesOffer, PostSalesOfferConfig, PostSalesOfferClaim, PriceVotingDoc, PricingRange, AutoSalesPricing, SalesPriceInPoints, FreeItemGroup, PeriodicMonthlySalesOffer, DiscountCouponType, DiscountCouponBook, SalesCouponsCodingMethod, CouponsSalesOrder, CouponsSalesOrderReturn, PriceVotingFile, AutoSalesPricingSetting
- [Comprehensive Reservation System Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/reservation-system-guide.html): This guide provides comprehensive documentation for the Reservation System in Nama ERP, intended for technical support staff and system administrators. - entities: ReservationDocument - menu: Inventory → Reservation Documents → Reservation Document
- [Delivery & Loading](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/delivery-and-loading.html): Between confirming the sales order and issuing the invoice lies the physical stage: preparing the goods, loading them, getting them to the customer, and obtaining proof of receipt. - entities: DeliveryDocument, LoadingDocument, DeliveryQueue, PickRules, DeliveryCancellationDoc, LoadingCancellationDoc, DeliveryQueueConfiguration, DeliveryDriverConfig, DeliveryOrganization
- [Assembly & Packaging](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/assembly-and-packaging.html): Not everything you sell is bought as-is; some items are assembled from components, or transformed and packaged before sale. - entities: AssemblyDocument, AssemblyBOM, ProcessingDoc, PackagingMethodFile, AssemblyRequest, AggrAssemblyDocument, MultiAssemblyDoc, PartialAssemblyBOM, AssemblyAltMaterial, AssemblyComponent, AssemblyProcessFile, AssemblyMachine
- [Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/quality-control.html): Not everything that arrives meets your standards, and not everything you produce is ready for the customer. - entities: QualityControlDoc, QualityControlReq, QualityAssuranceDoc, QualityAssuranceReq, QualityCheckList, QuestionClassification
- [Import Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/letters-of-credit.html): When you import goods from a supplier abroad, both parties need a guarantee: the supplier wants assured payment, and you want assured conforming shipment. - entities: LetterOfCredit, LCShipment, LCOpeningDoc, LcExpenseDocument, LetterOfCreditRequest, LCOpeningRequest, LCCostDoc, LCAction, LCProformaInvoice, LCShipmentProformaInvoice - menu: LC → Master Files → Letter Of Credit
- [Weight Scale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/weight-scale.html): In facilities that handle bulk materials sold or received by weight - grains, concrete, aggregates, metals - the scale becomes part of the workflow. - entities: WeightScaleConfig, WeightScalePreparationDoc, WeightScalePrepGenerator - menu: Inventory → Weight Scale → Weight Scale Configuration
- [Specialized Scenarios](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/specialized-scenarios.html): The previous pages cover the core supply chain paths. - entities: GlassJobOrder, GlassJobOrderReq, GlassOperationMap, OrderExecution, GlassJobOrderStatusUpdate, OrderDelivery, OrderFinished, OutsourceRequest, OutsourceIssue, OutsourceReceipt, OrderDamage, JOrderExpense, Tender, TenderCondition, SCDocRuleSet, SCExtraDocCreationRule, SCCopierExtraFields, OrderStatusQtyTrackConfig, DeliveryConfiguration, Resource, Activity, MaterialClassification
- [Ignoring Specific Warehouses/Locators in Reservation Quantity Check by Date](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/ignore-reservation-qty-check-by-date.html): This feature allows you to exclude specific warehouses or locators from the overdraft-by-date check calculation when performing Reservation operations only. - entities: Warehouse, Locator, ConfigEntry

#### Development Request Notes

- [Development Request Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/): Every now and then a client asks for something that changes how a core part of the Supply Chain module behaves — not a bug fix, but a deliberate new capability that touches inventory, costing, or...
- [Allowing Items With Batch & Expiry to Hold Untagged Quantities](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/allow-empty-item-dimensions-before-date.html): Development Request: SRDRQ06261 (Dar Al-Emirate Trading Company) - entities: ItemConfigurations - menu: Inventory → Settings → Item Configurations
- [Stock Receipts for the Unsatisfied Part of a Purchase Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/stock-receipt-for-unsatisfied-order-quantities.html): Development Request: SRDRQ06178 - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Document Terms

- [Sub-Item Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-sub-item.html): A sub-item (الصنف الفرعي) is a serialized/tracked sub-unit of an item that carries its own warehouse, locator, taxes, status and back-links to the documents that created or touched it. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Quantity Tracking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-quantity-tracking.html): These settings control quantity tracking — the engine that links documents and records how much of a source document has been satisfied by the documents created from it (for example, how much of a... - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Reservation & Delivery System](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-reservation-and-delivery.html): These settings control how a document reserves stock for its lines and how it participates in the delivery system — the system table that tracks an order through reservation, loading, and final... - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Pricing, Taxes & Discounts Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-pricing-taxes-discounts.html): This tab controls how unit prices, discounts, and taxes are calculated on documents created under the term — whether they are forced from price lists, recalculated on save, locked after a... - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Accounting Effects Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-accounting-effects.html): Supply Chain documents that carry accounting effects post to the general ledger through configurable debit and credit account sides. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Generation & Dimensions Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-generation-and-dimensions.html): This page covers two related areas of the supply-chain Document Term: how a document automatically generates downstream documents (on commit, or auto/async on save), and how the document's accounting... - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Document-Specific Options](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-document-specific.html): Most term-config options are shared across document types and are covered on the other pages (General, From-Document, Quantity Tracking, Reservation & Delivery, Pricing/Taxes/Discounts, Sub-Item). - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Freight Management

- [Freight Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/): Welcome to the Freight Management module of Nama ERP — the module built specifically for shipping, forwarding, customs-clearance, postal, and logistics companies, where the "goods" you sell aren't...
- [Freight Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-master-files.html): Before you create your first operation order, you need to define the building blocks every shipment is made of: which services you offer, in which containers, on which vessels, and to and from which... - entities: FRMServiceItem, FRMContainer, FRMContainerType, FRMContainerSize, FRMOceanVessel, ShippingPort, FRMSailingSchedule, FRMCommodity, FRMBillOfLadingType, FRMUOM, FRMCountry, FRMLocation
- [Operation Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/operation-orders.html): The operation order is the heart of the Freight Management module. - entities: FRMOperationOrder, FRMOOStatus, FRMOODelivery, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → FRM Operation Order
- [Bills of Lading](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/bills-of-lading.html): The bill of lading is the official shipping document that proves the carrier's receipt of the goods and the terms of their carriage and delivery. - entities: FRMBillOfLading - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → Bill of Lading
- [Price Lists & Markups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-pricing.html): A freight company profits from the difference between what it pays suppliers for a service and what it sells it to the customer for. - entities: FRMSalesPriceList, FRMPurchasePriceList, FRMEditPurchasePriceList
- [Invoices & Returns](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-invoicing.html): This is where operational work turns into financial effect: you sell services to the customer, buy them from suppliers, and track the difference between the two. - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMPurchaseInvoice, FRMSalesOrder, FRMSalesReturn, FRMPurchaseReturn
- [E-Invoicing in the Freight Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-einvoicing.html): The freight module's invoices plug into Nama ERP's e-invoicing framework exactly like ordinary sales invoices — they are Tax Authority Documents sent to the relevant authority (ZATCA in Saudi Arabia,... - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMServiceItem
- [International Postal System (IPS) — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-postal-intro.html): Alongside freight and logistics, the Freight Management module includes a complete system for running International Postal System (IPS) operations. - entities: IPSMailClass, IPSMailCategory, IPSMailSubclass, IPSMailCondition, IPSParcelStatus, IPSDeliveryAndReceiptArea, IPSMailRetentionReason, IPSNonDeliveryReason, IPSNonDeliveryMeasure, IPSEvent
- [Mail Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-mail-items.html): After the inbound receptacles are opened, the mail item becomes the focus of the work: it's recorded, transferred between offices, adjusted, stock-taken, and sorted for delivery. - entities: IPSMailItemManifest, IPSPostalParcelsSort, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailRetentionDocument
- [Receptacles](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-receptacles.html): A receptacle is the transport container that gathers several mail items for movement between offices — a sealed bag or box. - entities: IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSTransferReceptacles
- [Delivery Service](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-delivery.html): The final stage in a mail item's journey: delivering it to the customer and collecting the service value and any customs fees. - entities: IPSDeliveryRequest, IPSDeliveryInvoice, IPSDeliveryServiceItem, IPSDeliveryServicePrice
