#### Recruitment

- [Recruitment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/)
- [Vacancies & Candidates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/vacancies-and-candidates.html): Hiring in Nama starts before anyone applies. - entities: HRVacancy, HRVacancyType, HRCandidate, HRTest, HRTestResult
- [Job Offers & Tests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/job-offers-and-tests.html): A candidate who clears interviews and testing doesn't just get hired on a handshake — Nama puts the proposed terms of employment into their own document first, so the job title, salary package, and... - entities: JobOffer, CandidateJobOffer, AggregatedJobOffer, HRTest, HRTestResult
- [Work Starting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/work-starting.html): An offer being accepted, a suspension ending, a long vacation running its course — none of these, on their own, put a person back on the payroll. - entities: WorkStartingDocument, WorkStartingRequest, AggregatedVacationStartingDoc - menu: Payroll → Recruitment → Work Starting Document
- [Employee Relocation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/employee-relocation.html): People and their records change after they're hired: a branch gets restructured and someone's whole department moves, an employee needs a raise or a new job title, a passport gets renewed, or a... - entities: EmployeeRelocate, EmployeeRelocateRequest, UpdateEmployeeInfo, AggrUpdateEmpInfo, WorkPlaceUpdate

#### Training

- [Training](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/)
- [Training Courses & Plans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/training-courses-and-plans.html): Before anyone can be trained, there has to be something to train them in. - entities: TrainingCourse, TrainingPlan, CourseEnrollment, EndTrainingCourse
- [Course Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/hr-course-evaluation.html): Employee Evaluation rates ongoing staff performance against a catalog of scored criteria. - entities: CourseEvaluation, EvaluationElement - menu: Human Resources → Training → Course Evaluation

#### Provisions & End of Service

- [Provisions & End of Service](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/)
- [HR Provisions (End-of-Service & Vacation Accrual)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/hr-provisions.html): When an employee eventually leaves, the company owes them money it has been quietly building up for years: an end-of-service gratuity (a lump sum based on how long they served) and the cash value of... - entities: EmployeeProvisionsRecalc, EmployeeProvisionsOpening, AggrEmpProvisionsRecalc
- [Firing & Termination](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/firing-and-termination.html): Ending someone's employment is never just a status change. - entities: FiringDocument, FiringRequest, TerminationReason, AggFiringDocument, AggFiringRequest
- [Dues Liquidation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/dues-liquidation.html): When someone leaves the company, a single document has to draw a line under everything the two sides still owe each other and turn it into one number to pay. - entities: DuesLiquidationDoc, DuesLiquidationComponent, AggrDuesLiquidationDoc - menu: Payroll → Dues Liquidation and Firing → Dues Liquidation Document
- [Evacuation Approval](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/evacuation-approval.html): Before a departing employee can be paid off — or before a long leave is signed off — most companies run a clearance: the person has to be signed out by each department they owe something to. - entities: EvacuationPartyDocument, EvacuationApprovalSettings, EvacuationApprovalDocument

#### Government Relations

- [Government Relations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/)
- [Government Relations Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-relations-overview.html): Every company that employs expatriate staff in the Gulf runs a small back office that never stops: residency (Iqama) permits expire, work licences have to be renewed, exit and re-entry visas are... - entities: HOTransactionType, HODefinitionLetter, HOPaymentRequest
- [HR Visas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/hr-visas.html): An expatriate employee in the Gulf cannot simply leave the country and come back, or bring family over to visit, without a government visa each time — and every one of those visas has an issue date, a... - entities: HOExitReEntryVisaReq, AggrHOExitReEntryVisaReq, HOExtendingVisaReq, HOFinalExitVisaReq, HOFamilyVisitVisaRequest, HOPassportDeliveringReq
- [Residence Renewal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/residence-renewal.html): Of every deadline the PRO desk tracks, the Iqama (residency permit) is the one that cannot slip — an expired residency stops an employee from working, travelling or even opening a bank account. - entities: ResidenceRenewReq, AggrResidenceRenewReq - menu: Human Resources → ADMINISTRATIVE TRANSACTIONS → Residence Renew Request
- [Visa Pool](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/visa-pool.html): Before a single overseas hire can travel, the company needs a work visa allocated to them — and in Saudi / Gulf recruiting, those visas are not requested one at a time. - entities: HRIssuedVisas, HRVisasDelegation, HRVisaHandling
- [Social Insurance & Sponsorship](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/social-insurance-and-sponsorship.html): Two of the most sensitive government touch-points for an expatriate workforce are the GOSI social insurance register and the sponsorship (Kafala) relationship. - entities: HOEmpSocialInsuranceAdd, HOEmpSocialInsuranceRemove, HOSponsorshipTransferDoc, AggrHOSponsorshipTransferDoc
- [Government Penalties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-penalties.html): Alongside the visa and fee work, the government-relations desk maintains the company's disciplinary code — the internal list of workplace violations and the penalties attached to them — and issues the... - entities: HOViolationItem, HOViolationList, HOPenaltyDocument, HOPenaltyRequest

#### Health Insurance

- [Health Insurance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/health-insurance/)
- [Employee Health Insurance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/health-insurance/employee-health-insurance.html): In the Gulf, private health insurance is not optional paperwork — it is a government-mandated benefit, and covering the wrong category, missing a spouse, or letting a policy lapse creates real... - entities: EmployeeHealthInsurance, HealthInsuranceOffer, HealthInsuranceClaimDoc, HealthInsuranceUpgrade, HealthInsuranceCredence, EmpHealthInsurDelete

### Point of Sale

- [Point of Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/): Most of Nama ERP runs in a web browser.
- [Nama POS — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-overview.html): Most of Nama ERP runs in a web browser.
- [Installing Nama POS on a New Register and Connecting It to the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-installation.html): Nama POS is a desktop application that runs right on the cash register and keeps its own local database, so it can keep selling even when the connection to the central server drops.
- [Getting Started at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-getting-started.html): This page walks through the everyday basics: starting the application, signing in, finding your way around the menu, locking the screen when you step away, and switching language or theme.
- [The Sales Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-sales-invoice.html): The sales screen is where a cashier spends almost the whole day. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice - menu: Point of sale → Documents → POS Sales Invoice
- [Payment & Tender](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-payment-and-tender.html): Pressing F5 on a finished invoice opens the tender screen — the moment of truth where money changes hands. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice
- [Returns & Replacements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-returns-and-replacements.html): Goods come back. - entities: NamaPOSSalesReturn, NamaPOSSalesReplacement, NamaPOSCreditNote
- [Shifts & Cash](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-shifts-and-cash.html): A shift is one work session on a register: it opens when a cashier starts, and closes when they count down the drawer and hand over. - entities: POSShiftOpening, POSShiftClosing, POSReceiptFromRegister, POSPaymentToRegister
- [Tables, Reservations & Captain Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-tables-and-restaurant.html): Restaurants and cafés sell differently from a shop counter: orders belong to tables, waiters take them away from the till, and some are booked in advance. - entities: NamaPOSHall, NamaPOSTable, NamaPOSOrderReservation, NamaPOSCancelReservation
- [Item Add-ons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-item-addons.html): Some items are not sold plain. - entities: NamaPosItemAdditionalItems - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Item Additional Items
- [Inventory Operations at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-inventory-operations.html): A point of sale is not only a till — it is also the front line of the store's stock. - entities: NamaPOSStockReceipt, NamaPOSStockTransferReq, NamaPOSStockTakingDetails, NamaPOSScrapDoc, NamaPOSShortfallsDoc
- [Reports & Tools](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-reports-and-tools.html): Beyond selling, the register carries a handful of everyday tools: running reports, messaging other staff, checking a price without making a sale, and — for supervisors — running maintenance utilities. - entities: NamaPOSInternalMessage
- [How POS Data Syncs with the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-data-sync.html): This is the idea that makes Nama POS what it is, so it is worth understanding even if you never touch the technical side.
- [Nama POS — Technical Points of Use Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/nama-pos.html): Nama ERP is a web-based system, but its Nama POS module includes a dedicated desktop application for Points of Sale (POS), offering both online and offline capabilities: - entities: NamaPosPoleDisplaySpecs
- [Free Items in POS: Claim at Scan and Reconciliation at Payment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-free-items-claim-and-reconciliation.html): When you have a promotion of the "buy one item and get another for free" type, the default behavior in the POS is to add the free item to the invoice immediately upon adding the qualifying item.
- [Fingerprint Login in Point of Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-fingerprint-login.html): Imagine you have several employees taking turns at the same POS terminal throughout the day. - entities: UserFingerprint
- [Point of Sale FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-faq.html): When the option "Hide the system's default deferred payment method" is enabled in the POS settings, the deferred payment method is expected to be hidden from the payment screen.

### Real Estate

- [Real Estate](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/): Nama Real Estate is the module for companies whose product is property.
- [Real Estate Module Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/realestate-overview.html): A property company has a problem that ordinary trading companies do not: its stock is a tree.
- [Real Estate Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/realestate-configuration.html): Most of what the Real Estate module does is decided per document book, on the document's term.

#### Real Estate Document Terms

- [Real Estate Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/)
- [How Real Estate Document Terms Work](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-basics.html): A sales contract knows everything about the business event it records. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Sales Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-sales.html): Selling a property is not one accounting event. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Rent Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-rent.html): A lease is a promise stretched over time. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Collection, Maintenance, Investment and Cost Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-other.html): Once the two contract families are configured, everything else in Real Estate is a short term. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Properties

- [Properties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/)
- [How Properties Are Modelled](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-estate-model.html): Everything the Real Estate module does — selling, leasing, collecting, maintaining, revaluing — starts from one question: what exactly is being sold? Nama answers that question with a single idea...
- [Projects, Squares, Blocks and Land Plots](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-projects-blocks-lands.html): A land-subdivision business does not enter its portfolio plot by plot. - entities: REProject, RESquare, REBlock, RELand
- [Buildings, Floors and Rental Units](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-buildings-floors-and-units.html): The other half of the estate tree goes upwards instead of sideways. - entities: REBuilding, REFloor, RERentalUnit, REUnitGroup, REUnitModel
- [Owners, Buyers and Standard Contract Clauses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-owners-and-contract-clauses.html): Every document in the Real Estate module names people: the landlord who owns the building, the customer who buys the flat, the tenant who leases the shop, the investor who put money into the fund. - entities: REOwner, REStandardTermsConditions
- [Transferring Ownership Between Owners](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-ownership-transfer.html): Not every change of owner is a sale. - entities: REOwnerShipTransfer - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → OwnerShip Transfer Document

#### Sales

- [Sales](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/)
- [The Property Sales Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-sales-cycle.html): Selling a property is rarely one signature. - entities: RESalesOffer, RETempReservation
- [Price Lists and Payment Plan Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-price-lists-and-payment-methods.html): There are two numbers a salesperson should never type from memory: what the unit costs, and how the customer is allowed to pay for it. - entities: RESalesPriceList, RESalesPaymentMethod
- [Reservations and Initial Sales Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-reservations-and-initial-contracts.html): Between "the customer is interested" and "the customer has bought" there is a stretch of time where the unit must be taken off the market without any revenue being recognised. - entities: REReservationDoc, REReservationDocCancel, REInitialSalesContract
- [The Sales Contract](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-sales-contract.html): Everything before this point in the sales cycle is about intent. - entities: RESalesDoc - menu: Real Estate and Property → Sales → Sales Contract
- [Building the Installment Plan](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-installment-plans.html): Property is sold on time. - entities: RESalesDoc
- [Handing the Unit Over](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-handover.html): Handover is the moment the property stops being a promise on a contract and becomes a set of keys in somebody's hand. - entities: REEStateHandover, REInspectionDoc, PostHandoverCost
- [Waivers and Cancelling a Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-waiver-and-cancellation.html): Most readers arrive at this page with one of two questions. - entities: REWaiverDoc, RECancelContractReq - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Waiver Document

#### Rent

- [Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/)
- [The Leasing Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-cycle.html): A company owns Shop G-07 on the ground floor of Al-Nakheel Tower.
- [Rent Offers and Reserving a Unit for Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-offers.html): Before anybody signs anything, a prospective tenant wants a number: what would Shop G-07 cost for three years, and what is the deposit? The rent offer exists to answer that question on paper. - entities: RERentOffer, RERentOfferCancel - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent offer
- [The Rent Contract](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-contract.html): The rent contract is the document the whole leasing area revolves around. - entities: RERentContract - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent Contract
- [Generating the Rent Schedule](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-schedule.html): A lease is signed once, but it is paid many times. - entities: RERentContract, REMultiRentContract
- [Rent Installment Accrual Ledgers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-accrual-ledger.html): A rent contract is one document with one date. - entities: RERentInstallmentLedger - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent Installment Ledger
- [Renewing and Ending a Lease](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-renewal-and-termination.html): Every lease ends. - entities: RECancelContract, RERentContract - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Cancel Contract

#### Collections and Payments

- [Collections and Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/)
- [How Installment Collection Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collection-basics.html): Every contract in the Real Estate module ends up as a schedule of money: a sales contract, an opening sales contract, a rent contract, an opening rent contract, a reservation and even a waiver all...
- [Collect Documents and Bulk Collection](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collect-documents.html): The collect document (سند تحصيل) is where the money side of the Real Estate module actually happens. - entities: RECollectDoc, RECollectReq, AggrRECollectDoc
- [Paying Collected Money to the Bank or the Owner](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collection-payouts.html): Collecting rent is only half of a property agency's day. - entities: REBankPay, REOwnerPay
- [Exemptions and Returning Money to the Buyer](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-exemptions-and-returns.html): Not every installment is closed by cash. - entities: REExemptionDoc, REReturnPaymentDoc
- [Late-Payment Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-fines.html): A customer who is three months late on a 50,000 installment still owes 50,000. - entities: REFineDoc, REFineDocType - menu: Real Estate and Property → Fines → Real state fine Doc

#### Real Estate Maintenance

- [Real Estate Maintenance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/)
- [Maintenance Deposits and Maintenance Funds](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-deposits-and-funds.html): Before anything else, one correction that saves a lot of confusion: the Real Estate module runs two separate maintenance money streams, not one cycle. - entities: REMaintenanceFund, REMaintenanceDepositProfit, RESalesDoc
- [Accruing the Annual Maintenance Charge](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-accrual.html): A compound has to be run. - entities: REMaintenanceAccrual - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Maintenance Accrual
- [Maintenance Requests and Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-expenses.html): Accruing the annual charge tells you what the community owes. - entities: REMaintenanceExpense, REMaintenanceExpenseRequest - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Maintenance Expense

#### Investment

- [Investment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/investment/)
- [Real Estate Investment Funds](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/investment/realestate-investment-funds.html): A fund is a simple idea. - entities: REInvestmentFund, REFundFinanceAddition, REInvestorExit
- [Estate Values, Additions and Revaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/investment/realestate-estate-values-and-revaluation.html): Every property held by an investment fund carries a carrying value — what the books say it is worth today. - entities: RERevaluationDoc, REPurchaseContract, REEstateAddition
- [Agricultural Investment Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/investment/realestate-agricultural-investment.html): Start with what this is not, because the menu actively misleads. - entities: AgrInvestmentContract, AgrInvestContrProfitClaim, AgrInvestmentContractCategory

#### Real Estate Costs

- [Real Estate Costs](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/costs/)
- [Distributing Project Costs Over Properties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/costs/realestate-cost-distribution.html): A developer never buys a lift for flat 12. - entities: RECostDocument, REAdditionalCost
- [Fee, Commission, Broker and Expense Catalogues](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/costs/realestate-fee-commission-and-expense-types.html): Five small master files under Real Estate and Property > Master Files never appear on a screen of their own during day-to-day work. - entities: REFeeType, RECommissionType, REBroker, REExpenseType, REExpenseItem

#### Opening Balances

- [Opening Balances](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/opening/)
- [Going Live: Opening Balances in Real Estate](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/opening/realestate-opening-balances.html): The day a developer switches to Nama, nothing about his portfolio is new. - entities: REEstateOpeningCost
- [Opening Sales Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/opening/realestate-opening-sales.html): A villa was sold in 2023. - entities: REOpeningSales - menu: Real Estate and Property → Sales → Opening sales doc
- [Opening Rent Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/opening/realestate-opening-rent-contracts.html): A shop in Al-Nakheel Tower has been leased since early 2024: three years at 120,000 a year, paid quarterly, and the whole first year has already been collected. - entities: REOpeningRentContract - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Opening rent contract
- [Real Estate Investment FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/real-estate-fq.html): Question: In the Real Estate Investment Cost Document (RECostDocument), I need to extract the accounting journal entry based on the distribution the system created and added to the REEstateCostEntry... - entities: RECostDocument

### Contracting

- [Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/): Nama Contracting is the module for companies that build.
- [Contracting Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-overview.html): A contracting company lives on two mirrored promises.
- [Contracting Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-configuration.html): The Contracting module keeps its settings in a single record, and that record shapes the behaviour of every contract, extract and cost document in the database.

#### Contracting Master Files and Setup

- [Contracting Master Files and Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/)
- [Contracting Projects](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-projects.html): Ask a site manager what he is working on and he will not answer "contract PC-2026-001". - entities: Project - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Project
- [Standard Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-standard-terms.html): A contracting company does not sell things. - entities: ContractingStandardTerm - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Standard Term
- [Term Sheets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-term-sheets.html): A term sheet is a bill of quantities saved as a document. - entities: TermSheet - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Term Sheet
- [Term Analysis Cards](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-term-analysis-cards.html): A term line says "plain concrete, 300 m³, 420 each". - entities: TermAnalysisCard - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Term Analysis Card
- [Contract Conditions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-conditions.html): Every construction contract carries clauses that move money without being work: retain 5% of each payment until final handover, recover the mobilisation advance at 20% of every certificate, deduct... - entities: ContractingCondition, ContractingConditionsGroup - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Condition
- [Contracting Price Lists](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-price-lists.html): Typing a unit rate onto every line of every bill of quantities is how estimating mistakes happen. - entities: ContractingPriceList - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Price list
- [Phases and Work Areas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-phases-and-work-areas.html): A bill of quantities answers what work is being done. - entities: ContractingPhase, ContractingPhasesGroup, ContrWorkArea
- [Contract Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contract-templates.html): Contractors repeat themselves. - entities: ContractTemplate - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contract Template
- [Contractors and Consultants](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contractors-and-consultants.html): Two parties stand beside the project owner on every construction job, and the module keeps a master file for each of them. - entities: Contractor, ContractingAdvisory, ContractorClassification
- [Units, Tasks and Other Lookups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-lookups.html): Six small master files sit under Contracting > Master Files and do not deserve a page each. - entities: ContractingUOM, ContractingTask, ContrTermCategory, ContrTermCategory2, ContractingFineReason, ContractingDirectCost, ContractingTaxExtractTerm

#### Contracting Document Terms

- [Contracting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/)
- [Document Terms Basics](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-basics.html): A document term (توجيه المستند) is the small configuration record that tells one document type how to behave — and, above everything else in Contracting, which accounts it posts to. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Extract Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-extracts.html): The extract is the only document in a contracting chain that reaches the ledger, which makes its term the most consequential piece of configuration in the module. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Material and Payment Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-materials.html): The terms on this page cover two families that look unrelated and turn out to be closely connected: the documents that move material onto a site, and the documents that move money in advance of an... - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Other Contracting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-other.html): Once the extracts, the material streams and the payment documents are configured, what remains is a long tail of terms that are mostly very small: one debit, one credit, and a guard or two. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Project Contracting

- [Project Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/)
- [The Project Contracting Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-owner-cycle.html): A contracting business runs two mirrored chains at the same time. - entities: ContractingJobOrder - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Job Order
- [Contracting Offers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-offers.html): Every contract in this module starts as a number somebody had to justify. - entities: ContractingOffer - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Offer
- [Contracting Assays](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-assays.html): The document this page describes is مقايسة مقاولات — a priced bill of quantities, the classic Arabic construction term for a measured schedule of works with quantities and rates. - entities: ContractingAssay - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Assay
- [Project Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract.html): The project contract is the centre of gravity of the whole contracting module. - entities: ProjectContract - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract
- [Project Contract Updates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract-updates.html): Clients change their minds. - entities: ProjectContractUpdate - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Update
- [Project Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-execution.html): A month of work has happened on site. - entities: ProjContractExecution - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Execution
- [Project Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-extracts.html): Signing a contract in Nama books nothing. - entities: ProjContrExtract - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Extract
- [Taxes on Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-extract-taxes.html): A tax authority will not accept a bill of quantities. - entities: ProjContrExtract, ContractingTaxExtractTerm
- [Project Advance Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-advances.html): Nobody mobilises a tower crane out of goodwill. - entities: ProjectAdvancePayment - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Advance Payment
- [Project Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-fines.html): Contracts have teeth. - entities: ProjectContractFine - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Fine
- [Measurements, Submittals and Handover](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-measurements-and-approvals.html): Three documents sit around the edges of the billing chain: one before the contract is even priced, one that governs what materials may be bought, and one that records the day the keys change hands. - entities: MeasurementsRequest, CustomerSubmittal, ProjectDeliverLetter

#### Subcontractor Contracting

- [Subcontractor Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/)
- [The Subcontractor Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-cycle.html): A contracting business runs two mirrored chains at once.
- [Subcontractor Offers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-offers.html): Before you award a package you ask two or three firms what they want for it. - entities: ContractorContractOffer - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Offer
- [Subcontracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-contract.html): The subcontract is the centre of gravity of the cost side, exactly as the project contract is of the revenue side: the rates you have agreed to pay one firm for one package, the clauses that will... - entities: ContractorContract - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract
- [Subcontract Updates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-contract-updates.html): Scope moves. - entities: ContractorContractUpdate - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Update
- [Subcontractor Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-execution.html): A subcontractor's invoice is only as trustworthy as the measurement behind it. - entities: ContractorContractExecution - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Execution
- [Subcontractor Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-extracts.html): Everything else on the subcontractor side is preparation. - entities: ContractorContrExtract - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Extract
- [Subcontractor Advances and Other Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-advances-and-payments.html): A blockwork subcontractor cannot start without buying scaffolding, hiring a gang and putting a mixer on site, and he will not have been paid a penny yet because nothing has been measured. - entities: ContractorAdvancePayment, ContractorOtherPayment - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Advance Payment
- [Subcontractor Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-fines.html): A blockwork gang builds forty square metres of wall out of plumb and has to knock it down and build it again. - entities: ContractorContractFine - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Fine

#### Budgets

- [Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/)
- [Estimated Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/contracting-estimated-budget.html): Winning a job at 230,000 tells you what the client will pay. - entities: ContractingEstimatedBudget - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Estimated Budget
- [Executive Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/contracting-executive-budget.html): The estimated budget is what the estimating team thinks the job will cost. - entities: ContractingExecutiveBudget - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Executive Budget
- [Budget Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/contracting-budget-execution.html): The English name on the menu invites you to expect a variance report — budget against actual, in one screen. - entities: ContractingBudgetExecution - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contracting Budget Execution Document
- [Budget Item Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/contracting-budget-item-requests.html): An approved executive budget says which materials the job needs, how much of each, and at what price the client approved them. - entities: ExecutiveBudgetItemRequest - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Executive Budget Item Request

#### Contracting Costs

- [Contracting Costs](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/)
- [How Project Cost Is Built](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-cost-model.html): Knowing what a project is worth is easy: the contract says 230,000, term by term, and nobody argues about it. - entities: ContractingDirectCost
- [Cost Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-cost-execution.html): The contract's term lines will tell you that blockwork has cost 34,800 so far. - entities: ContractingCostExecution - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contracting Cost Execution
- [Issuing Material to a Project](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-project-materials.html): Two menu items sitting next to each other under Contracting > Costs look almost identical and behave nothing alike. - entities: ContractingMaterialIssue, ContractingMaterialReturn, ContractingMaterialIssueReq - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contracting Material Issue
- [Selling Material to a Subcontractor](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-contractor-materials.html): Contractors supply their subcontractors constantly. - entities: ContractorMaterialIssue, ContractorMaterialReturn, ContractorMaterialIssueRequest - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contractor Material Issue
- [Contracting Purchase Requests and Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-purchasing.html): Nama already has a perfectly serviceable purchase request and purchase order in the supply chain module. - entities: ContractingPurchaseRequest, ContractingPurchaseOrder
- [Miscellaneous Contracting Spend](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-misc-spend.html): Most of what a site costs is not an item in a warehouse. - entities: MiscContractingInvoice, MiscContractingOrder, MiscContractingRequest - menu: Contracting → Costs → Misc Contracting Invoice
- [Daily Labour and Site Diary](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-daily-labour.html): Two documents in this part of the module are written by the people who are actually on site, at the end of the day, in their own handwriting before anyone types them up. - entities: DailyLaborBook, DailyEngineeringDoings - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Daily Labor Book
- [Employees, Equipment and Their Costs](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-equipment-and-allocations.html): The site engineer who spends March on Tower A is on the company payroll. - entities: ContrEmployeeEquipmentAlloc, ContrEmployeeEquipmentCost, ContrEmployeeEquipInvoice, EquipmentStatementDoc, FACreationDoc
- [Pushing Cost onto Real Estate Units](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-realestate-cost-bridge.html): A contractor working on somebody else's land only ever needs cost per term: what did the blockwork cost, what did the plastering cost, are we inside the rate we tendered.

#### Contracting Quality Control

- [Contracting Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/)
- [Site Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-quality-overview.html): Every construction site runs on paper.
- [Inspection and Test Plans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-inspection-plans.html): An ITP — an Inspection and Test Plan — is the document a contractor submits at the start of a job to answer one question in advance: for every activity on this project, what will be inspected, against... - entities: CQCITP, CQCITPRegister
- [Activity Inspection Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-activity-inspections.html): Reinforcement gets covered by concrete. - entities: CQCActivityInspectionReq - menu: Contracting → Quality → Activity Inspection Request
- [Material Inspection on Delivery](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-material-inspection.html): A lorry arrives at the site gate. - entities: CQCMaterialReceipt, CQCMRRRegister
- [Site Checklists and Test Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-site-checklists.html): Eight of the thirteen screens in the Quality group are specific site forms — the sheet you fill before a pour, the sheet you fill after it, the one for a buried pipe run, the one for a pressure test. - entities: FinishingWorksCheckList, DiggingBackFilingCheckList, CQCPreConcreteInspection, CQCPostConcreteInspection, CQCUndergroundPipingChecks, CQCCleaningAndFlushing, CQCHydroStaticFireSysTest, TestReport
- [Contracting FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-faq.html): These are the questions that come up again and again on live Contracting installations.

### Project Management

- [Project Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/): Project Management (ECPA) is the Nama module for firms whose product is professional time rather than goods: architecture and engineering offices, consultancies, audit and legal practices, design...
- [Project Management (ECPA) Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-overview.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa — one code for the whole module, all or nothing.
- [Project Management Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-configuration.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa — one code for the whole module. - entities: ConfigEntry
- [Where Project Cost and Revenue Come From](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-costing-and-profitability.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa. - entities: CPAProject, CPAProjectStage
- [Project Management Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-reports.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa.

#### Projects

- [Projects](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/)
- [Project Types, Classes and Disciplines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-setup.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa — one code for the whole module. - entities: CPAProjectType, CPAProjectSubType, CPAProjectClass, CPADiscipline
- [Milestones and the Phase–Discipline Matrix](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-milestones-and-matrix.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa — one code for the whole module. - entities: CPAProjectMileStone, CPAPhasesDisciplineGroup, CPAProject
- [The Managed Project](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-managed-project.html): Everything in Project Management (ECPA) hangs off one record: the Managed Project. - entities: CPAProject - menu: ECPA → Projects → Managed Project
- [Project Sales Quotation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-sales-quotation.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa — one code for the whole module. - entities: CPASalesQuotation - menu: ECPA → Projects → CPA Projects Sales Quotation
- [Project Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-templates.html): Most firms do the same handful of jobs over and over. - entities: CPATemplateProject - menu: ECPA → Projects → Template Project
- [Project Stages](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-stages.html): Most of Project Management (ECPA) is built around people and hours. - entities: CPAProjectStage - menu: ECPA → Projects → Project Stage
- [Stage Extensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-stage-extensions.html): A Project Stage holds the promise: each phase, its targeted number of days, and the dates that follow from them. - entities: CPAProjectStageExtension, CPAStageExtensionReason, CPAStageExtensionReasonType - menu: ECPA → Projects → Project Stage Extension
- [Procedures](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-procedures.html): The name invites a misunderstanding, so start here: a Procedure in Project Management (ECPA) is not a workflow definition, not a checklist template and not a stored routine. - entities: CPAProcedure - menu: ECPA → Projects → Procedure

#### Tasks

- [Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/tasks/)
- [Project Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/tasks/ecpa-tasks.html): A project in Project Management (ECPA) is a container: a customer, a set of milestones, a set of disciplines. - entities: CPATask, CPATaskType - menu: ECPA → Tasks → Task

#### Task Execution

- [Task Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/task-execution/)
- [Recording Worked Hours](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/task-execution/ecpa-timesheets.html): Everything a professional-services firm sells passes through this screen. - entities: CPATimeSheet, CPATimeSheetRequest - menu: ECPA → Task Execution / Approvals → Tasks Executing
- [Approving Worked Hours](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/task-execution/ecpa-timesheet-approval.html): Hours recorded on a Tasks Executing document are a claim, not a fact. - entities: CPATimeSheetApproval - menu: ECPA → Task Execution / Approvals → TimeSheet Approval

#### Expenses

- [Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/expenses/)
- [Project Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/expenses/ecpa-project-expenses.html): ::: info Licence All three screens on this page are gated on the ecpa licence code. - entities: CPAProjExpenseReq, CPAProjExpenseDoc, CPAProjectExpenseItem

#### Invoicing

- [Invoicing](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/invoicing/)
- [Project Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/invoicing/ecpa-project-invoice.html): ::: info Required licence ecpa — one code for the whole module. - entities: CPAProjectInvoice - menu: ECPA → Invoice → Project Invoice
- [Project Return](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/invoicing/ecpa-project-returns.html): ::: info Licence The Project Return screen is part of Project Management (ECPA) and is gated on the ecpa licence code. - entities: CPAProjectReturn - menu: ECPA → Invoice → Project Return
- [Document Terms for Project Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/invoicing/ecpa-document-terms.html): ::: info Licence Every term described on this page belongs to a Project Management (ECPA) document type and needs the ecpa licence code. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Fixed Assets

- [Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/): Nama Fixed Assets is the register of everything your company owns and uses rather than sells — machines, vehicles, buildings, furniture, land.
- [Fixed Assets Module Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-overview.html): The general ledger knows that you own machinery worth 2,400,000 and that 400,000 of depreciation has piled up against it.
- [Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-configuration.html): Most of what the Fixed Assets module does is decided document by document, on the document's term (توجيه). - menu: Assets → Settings
- [Getting Started](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-getting-started.html): Setting up Fixed Assets in a fresh database is not hard, but the order matters more than in most modules.

#### Master Files and Setup

- [Master Files and Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/)
- [Fixed Asset Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-types.html): Al-Waha Industries owns forty machines. - entities: FAType - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Type
- [The Fixed Asset Record](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-master.html): There is one rule that explains the whole of this screen, and reading it first will save you an hour of hunting for a field that does not exist: - entities: FixedAsset - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset
- [Asset Statuses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-status.html): The Status field on a fixed asset is one word, it cannot be typed, and it decides more about what you are allowed to do than any other field on the record. - entities: FixedAsset - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset
- [Classifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-classifications.html): Al-Waha Industries has three hundred assets and one asset type for all of its machinery. - entities: FAClassification1, FAClassification2, FAClassification3, FAClassification4, FAClassification5
- [Asset Locations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-locations.html): An asset register that cannot tell you where the machine is standing is only half a register. - entities: FALocation - menu: Assets → Master Files → Asset Location
- [Components and Component Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-components.html): The CNC machine MCH-0007 is one asset, one cost, one depreciation schedule. - entities: FAComponentType - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Component Type
- [The Fixed Asset Creation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-creation-document.html): A contracting company spends a year building a warehouse. - entities: FACreationDoc - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Creation Document

#### Acquiring Assets

- [Acquiring Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/)
- [How an Asset Is Acquired](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-acquisition-cycle.html): Buying a machine is not one event.
- [Fixed Asset Purchase Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-request.html): The purchase request is the internal ask: the paint shop needs a compressor, production needs a CNC cutting machine. - entities: FAPurchaseRequest - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Purchase Request
- [Offers and Purchase Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-offers-and-orders.html): Between "we need a CNC machine" and "here is the supplier's invoice" sit the two documents where purchasing does its work: the Fixed Asset Offer (عرض سعر أصل), which records what a supplier is willing... - entities: FAPurchaseOffer, FAPurchaseOrder
- [The Fixed Asset Purchase Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-document.html): Everything before this document is paperwork. - entities: FAPurchaseDocument - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Purchase Document
- [Taking Delivery: Initial Receipt and Receipt Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-receipts.html): Two documents in this module have "receipt" in their name, they sit in different menu folders, they need different licences, and they do completely different jobs. - entities: FAInitialReceipt, FAReceiptDoc
- [Opening Balances for Assets You Already Own](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-opening-balances.html): Almost nobody starts using Fixed Assets on the day they buy their first machine. - entities: FAOpeningDocument, FAOpeningDocumentUpdate - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Opening Document
- [Custodies Delivery Receipt Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-delivery-receipt.html): People leave. - entities: FADeliveryReceiptDoc - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Custodies Delivery Receipt Document

#### Letters of Credit

- [Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/)
- [Importing Assets on a Letter of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-overview.html): A press bought from a factory down the road costs what the invoice says it costs.
- [The Letter of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-letter-of-credit.html): Everything about one import deal has to hang off a single peg: the proforma invoice, half a dozen expense invoices from four different parties, and finally the document that turns all of it into asset... - entities: FALetterOfCredit - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed asset Letter of Credit
- [The Proforma Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-proforma-invoice.html): The Fixed Asset ProformaInvoice is the shortest document in the chain and the most misunderstood. - entities: FALCProformaInvoice - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset ProformaInvoice
- [Expenses and Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-expenses.html): This is where the import stops being paperwork and starts being money. - entities: FALcExpenseDocument, AdditionalCost - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset Expense Document
- [The Cost Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-cost-document.html): Up to this point the import has cost 615,000 and nobody owns a press. - entities: FALCCostDoc - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset Letter of Credit cost

#### Depreciation and Value Changes

- [Depreciation and Value Changes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/)
- [How Depreciation Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-depreciation-concepts.html): Everything the Fixed Assets module does with depreciation comes out of a single line of arithmetic applied once per fiscal period.
- [The Depreciation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-depreciation-document.html): The depreciation document is the period-end run: one document per fiscal period, holding one line per asset, each line carrying that asset's charge for the period. - entities: FADepreciation - menu: Assets → Documents → Depreciation Document
- [The Aggregated Depreciation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-aggregated-depreciation.html): Al-Waha Industries goes live on Nama in November, backdated to the start of the year. - entities: AggrFADepreciation - menu: Assets → Documents → Aggregated Depreciation Document
- [Freezing an Asset's Depreciation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-prevent-depreciation.html): Sometimes an asset should not be depreciated for a while. - entities: FAPreventAssetsDeprec - menu: Assets → Documents → Prevent Assets Depreciation Document
- [Revaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-revaluation.html): Some assets do not lose value on a formula. - entities: FARevaluation - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Revaluation
- [Additions and Deductions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-additions-and-deductions.html): In January 2027 Al-Waha's CNC machine gets a new control unit. - entities: FAAdditionDeduction, AggrAdditionDeduction - menu: Assets → Documents → Asset addition deduction
- [Re-estimating an Asset's Life and Salvage Value](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-properties-document.html): Useful life and salvage value are estimates, and estimates get revised. - entities: FAPropertiesDocument, AggrFAPropertiesDocument - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Properties

#### Transfers and Stocktaking

- [Transfers and Stocktaking](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/)
- [Moving an Asset: The Transfer Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-transfer-document.html): Al-Waha Industries wheels the CNC cutting machine MCH-0007 from Hall 2 to Hall 3 of the Riyadh plant. - entities: FATransferDocument, AggrFATransferDoc - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Transfer document
- [Asking for a Move: The Transfer Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-transfer-requests.html): In most plants the person who decides that a machine should move is not the person who is allowed to change the asset register. - entities: FATransferRequest, AggFATransferRequest - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Fixed Asset Transfer Request
- [Transfers Between Companies](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-intercompany-transfers.html): Moving a machine between two branches of one company is bookkeeping housekeeping: the same balances sit under a different label. - entities: FATransferDocument - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Transfer document
- [Sending Assets Out and Bringing Them Back](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-movement-in-out.html): Al-Waha Industries is exhibiting at a trade fair in Dammam. - entities: FAMovementOutDoc, FAMovementInDoc
- [Stocktaking Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-stocktaking.html): Once a year somebody walks the plant with a scanner and finds out what is actually there. - entities: FAFixedAssetsTaking - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → FixedAssets Taking Document

#### Disposal

- [Disposal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/)
- [Disposing of an Asset](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/fixedassets-disposal.html): Sooner or later every machine leaves. - entities: FADisposalDocument - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed assets disposal document
- [Partial Disposal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/fixedassets-partial-disposal.html): Not every asset record is one thing. - entities: FAPartialDisposalDoc - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Partial Disposal Document
- [Disposing of Many Assets at Once](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/fixedassets-aggregated-disposal.html): Year-end tidying tends to arrive in batches. - entities: AggrFADisposalDoc - menu: Assets → Documents → Aggregated Fixed Asset Disposal Document

#### Custodies

- [Custodies](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/)
- [Custody — Items Handed to Staff](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-overview.html): In the same week, Al-Waha Industries buys two things.
- [Custody Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-types.html): Before Al-Waha Industries can register its first laptop, somebody has to answer a question the system will otherwise ask on every single record: do items of this kind have a money value? - entities: CustodyType - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody Type
- [The Custody Record](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-register.html): The custody record is the register itself — one record for one physical item that Al-Waha Industries has handed out, or is about to. - entities: FACustody - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody
- [Buying Custody Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-purchase.html): Al-Waha Industries buys a laptop for 6,000 from Riyadh IT Supplies. - entities: FACustodyPurchaseDocument - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody purchase document
- [Delivering and Transferring Custody](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-delivery-and-transfer.html): A custody item that nobody is holding is just stock. - entities: FACustodyDeliveryDoc, FACustodyTransferDocument
- [Disposing of a Custody Item](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-disposal.html): Eventually the laptop stops being worth keeping. - entities: FACustodyDisposal - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody Disposal

#### Maintenance

- [Maintenance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/maintenance/)
- [Maintenance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/maintenance/fixedassets-maintenance-overview.html): A CNC machine that cost 240,000 does not survive five years on its own.
- [Maintenance Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/maintenance/fixedassets-maintenance-types.html): A workshop does not do "maintenance". - entities: FAMaintenanceType - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Maintenance → Maintenance Type
- [Checklists and Checklist Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/maintenance/fixedassets-maintenance-checklists.html): Ask a technician to "service the CNC machine" and you will get a different job every quarter, depending on who turns up. - entities: FAMaintenanceCheckList, FACheckListItem
- [Maintenance Plans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/maintenance/fixedassets-maintenance-plans.html): A maintenance plan is the year's service calendar written down: this machine, this kind of maintenance, on this date, by this contractor — repeated for as many visits as you intend to make. - entities: FAMaintenancePlan - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Maintenance → Maintenance plan
- [Maintenance Records and Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/maintenance/fixedassets-maintenance-records.html): Everything else in this area is preparation. - entities: FAMaintenanceRecord, FAMaintenanceRecordRequest - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Maintenance → Maintenance Record

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/document-terms/)
- [How Fixed Asset Document Terms Work](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/document-terms/fixedassets-terms-basics.html): A fixed asset document knows what happened. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Terms for Acquiring Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/document-terms/fixedassets-terms-acquisition.html): Everything in this group answers one question: when an asset arrives, who gets credited? The asset side of the entry is never in doubt — it is the asset's own cost account, taken from its accounts... - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Terms for Depreciation, Value Changes and Disposal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/document-terms/fixedassets-terms-depreciation-and-disposal.html): These are the terms that decide what the ledger sees while an asset is in service, and what it sees on the day the asset leaves. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Terms for Custody and Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/document-terms/fixedassets-terms-custody-and-lc.html): Two chains in this module keep their own accounting, and both are configured differently enough from the main asset documents to deserve their own page. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Service Center

- [Service Center](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/): Nama Service Center is built for the motor trade.
- [Service Center Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-overview.html): From the street, a car dealership and its workshop look like one business.
- [Setting Up a Service Center](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-getting-started.html): Standing this module up in a fresh database is less about the number of screens and more about the order you touch them in, and about three or four decisions that are cheap to make now and painful to...
- [Service Center Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-configuration.html): Almost everything that changes how this module behaves is configured per document book, on the document term.
- [Reports and Print Forms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-reports-and-forms.html): Set your expectations before you go looking: this module ships almost no reporting at all.

#### Workshop Setup

- [Workshop Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/)
- [Work Centers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-work-centers.html): Al-Sahra Motors runs two halls behind the showroom: a mechanical hall where oil changes, brakes and air-conditioning work happen, and a body-and-paint hall. - entities: SrvCWorkCenter - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Service Center Work Center
- [Service Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-tasks.html): A workshop sells time. - entities: SrvCTask - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Service Center Task
- [Services and Operation Groups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-operations.html): A customer does not ask for "an oil change, a filter change, a brake inspection and a fluid top-up". - entities: SrvCOperation - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Service Center Operation
- [The Serviced Product](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-product-file.html): When Fahad Al-Otaibi brings his NAWA Saif 1.6 in for its service, the workshop needs somewhere to keep the things that are true about that car rather than about this visit: its chassis number, its... - entities: SrvCProduct - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Product
- [Brands, Models and Model Categories](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-brands-and-models.html): Al-Sahra Motors services NAWA cars, and a NAWA Saif 1.6 is not a NAWA Rimal 2.4. - entities: SrvProductModel, SrvcBrand, SrvProductModelCategory
- [Tags and Classification Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-classification-files.html): Three small master files sit in the Service Center menu that a reader will reasonably expect to do something — and none of them does. - entities: AccessoriesKit, SrvCVisitType, SrvCOperationClassification

#### Job Order Cycle

- [Job Order Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/)

- [Job Estimations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-estimation.html): The job estimation (مقايسة) is the quote. - entities: SrvCJobEstimation, SrvCJobEstimationUpdate - menu: Service Center → Documents → Job Estimation
- [The Job Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-order.html): The job order (أمر شغل) is the centre of the module. - entities: SrvCJobOrder, SrvcAddTaskToJobOrder - menu: Service Center → Documents → Service Center Job Order
- [Who Pays for What](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-payer-split.html): In an ordinary workshop the bill goes to whoever brought the car in. - entities: SrvCJobOrder
- [Closing a Job Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-order-closing.html): The car is finished, the parts have been fitted, the technicians have booked their time. - entities: SrvCJobOrderClosing - menu: Service Center → Documents → Job Order Closing
- [Invoicing a Job Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-order-invoicing.html): One repair, up to three invoices. - entities: SrvCJobOrder
- [Gate Pass](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-gate-pass.html): The gate pass (تصريح عبور البوابة) answers one question, and only one: - entities: SrvCGatePass - menu: Service Center → Documents → Service Center Gate Pass
- [Odometer Readings and Service Intervals](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-odometer-and-service-intervals.html): Everything in a workshop that repeats — the oil change, the belt, the major service — repeats by distance, not by date. - entities: SrvCKiloMetrage, SrvCProductTaskOpeningDoc - menu: Service Center → Documents → Kilo Metrage

#### Workshop Execution

### Customer Relationship Management

- [Customer Relationship Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/): The CRM menu covers the whole life of a customer relationship on paper: chasing a lead, logging the calls and visits that warm it up, running campaigns and surveys, answering complaints and support...
- [CRM Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-overview.html): The Customer Relationship Management menu — «خدمة العملاء» — is one of the widest branches in Nama ERP.
- [CRM Getting Started](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-getting-started.html): Because the CRM menu holds four separate products, there is no single setup order that covers all of it.
- [CRM Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-configuration.html): The CRM module has its own settings screen, reached from the configuration area rather than from the CRM menu itself.
- [CRM Reports and Printed Forms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-reports-and-forms.html): This is a short page, and the shortness is the point.

#### Sales Pipeline

- [Sales Pipeline](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/sales-pipeline/)
- [Sales Pipeline Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/sales-pipeline/crm-pipeline-overview.html): Al Nokhba Air Conditioning Systems met Marina Plaza Hotels on a stand at the International Cooling Expo on 8 January 2026.
- [Leads](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/sales-pipeline/crm-leads.html): A lead is the record you open the moment a prospect becomes real enough to remember. - entities: CRMLead - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Marketing → CRM Lead
- [Potentials](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/sales-pipeline/crm-potentials.html): On 2 February 2026, three weeks after the first call and a fortnight after the site visit, Hala pressed Convert To Potential on LD-00417 and saved PT-00203. - entities: CRMPotential - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Marketing → CRM Potential
- [Converting a Lead](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/sales-pipeline/crm-lead-conversion.html): There are four conversion buttons on the Lead and Potential screens, and they all work the same way: each one opens a new, unsaved screen with some fields already filled in, and then gets out of your... - entities: CRMLead, CRMPotential
- [Offers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/sales-pipeline/crm-offers.html): The screen called Offer (CRM عرض) is the most commonly misread thing in the CRM menu, and it is worth clearing up in the first paragraph: it is not a price offer. - entities: CRMOffers - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Marketing → Offer
- [Projects, Analysis and Development Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/sales-pipeline/crm-projects-and-analysis.html): Three more screens sit in the CRM menu alongside the pipeline, and all three describe delivery rather than selling: what was analysed, what has to be built or taught, and what was sent back to be... - entities: CRMProject, CRMAnalysis, CRMDevelopmentRequest

#### Questionnaires

- [Questionnaires](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/questionnaires/)

- [CRM Questionnaires](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/questionnaires/crm-questionnaires.html): The template is the survey; the questionnaire (استبيان) is one filled-in copy of it. - entities: CRMQuestionair - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Questionairs → Questionair

- [Fault Catalogues](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/maintenance-setup/crm-fault-catalogues.html): When the Marina Plaza crew opens a chiller and finds high discharge pressure, three people need to understand what happened: the technician writing it up, the supervisor deciding how urgent it is, and... - entities: MnDysfunction, MnTroubleLevel, MnTroubleDescription, MnNoticeCategory
- [The Service Catalogue](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/maintenance-setup/crm-maintenance-service-catalogue.html): A maintenance business does not only sell parts. - entities: MnMaintenanceService - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Maintenance Files → Machine Maintenance Service
- [Task Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/maintenance-setup/crm-maintenance-task-templates.html): A monthly chiller service is three things: replace the air filter, check the oil level, record the running hours. - entities: MnTaskTemplate, MnMaintenanceGroup - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Maintenance Files → Maintenance Task Template
- [Order and Visit Statuses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/maintenance-setup/crm-maintenance-statuses.html): Everything about how a maintenance order behaves — whether the system understands it as open, running, held or done — comes down to one small field on one small master file. - entities: MnMaintenanceOrderStatus, MnVisitStatus

- [Daily Dispatch](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/maintenance-cycle/crm-maintenance-dispatch.html): A call-centre takes fault reports all day. - entities: MnPlan, MnItinerary - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Maintenance Documents → CRM Maintenance Plan
