- [Field Maps in Nama ERP - Complete Guide (AI-Generated by Claude.ai)](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/ai-generated-field-maps-documentation.html): Field maps are a powerful feature in Nama ERP that allow automatic copying and transformation of data between different entities (records).
- [DeleteRelatedEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/DeleteRelatedEntityAction.html): Deletes related entities that were previously generated by EAGenerateEntityFromEntityAction.
- [EAAllowUseAsFromDocOfAField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAllowUseAsFromDocOfAField.html): Allows a specific field to be used as a source document reference ("from doc") in document creation workflows.
- [EAAltCodeValidator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAltCodeValidator.html): Validates the alternative code (altCode) field of entities to ensure they follow specific formatting requirements.
- [EAAttachReportResultToRecord](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAttachReportResultToRecord.html): Generates reports automatically and attaches the resulting files as attachments to the current entity record.
- [EAAutoCollectSignAndSentEInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoCollectSignAndSentEInvoice.html): Automates the complete Saudi ZATCA e-Invoice submission process by collecting eligible invoices, creating submission documents, digitally signing them, and sending them to the tax authority.
- [EAAutoEscalateApprovalToFallBackEmployee](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoEscalateApprovalToFallBackEmployee.html): Automatically escalates overdue approval cases to the fallback employee defined in the approval definition.
- [EAAutoEscalateApprovalToSupervisor](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoEscalateApprovalToSupervisor.html): Automatically escalates overdue approval cases to the supervisor of the assigned employee when timeout periods are exceeded.
- [EAAutoSendEInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoSendEInvoice.html): Automatically submits individual invoices to tax authorities (ZATCA/Egyptian Tax Authority) immediately after invoice creation or modification.
- [EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityAction.html): Automatically generates related entities from source entities and handles their deletion when the source entity is deleted.
- [EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval.html): Automatically generates related entities from source entities while respecting approval workflows.
- [EACacheEvicter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACacheEvicter.html): Clears Hibernate second-level cache for a specific entity type, ensuring cached data is refreshed and subsequent queries retrieve current information from the database.
- [EACalcCurrencyRate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACalcCurrencyRate.html): Automatically calculates and sets exchange rates for foreign currency transactions on document entities.
- [EACalcCurrencyRateInDetails](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACalcCurrencyRateInDetails.html): Calculates and sets exchange rates for foreign currencies in document detail lines (collections).
- [EACheckAndUpdateLinkAtOnlinePaymentTransactionSysEntry](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckAndUpdateLinkAtOnlinePaymentTransactionSysEntry.html): Performs maintenance on online payment transaction entries by checking for expired payment links and updating their status.
- [EACheckDailyBackupOnGoogleDrive](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckDailyBackupOnGoogleDrive.html): Monitors Google Drive folders for backup files, verifying daily backups were created successfully.
- [EACheckTaxAuthorityRejectedByReceiverDocuments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckTaxAuthorityRejectedByReceiverDocuments.html): Automatically checks tax authority status for documents within their 3-day review window (from document date) and updates their status in the system.
- [EAClearGoogleDriveTrash](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAClearGoogleDriveTrash.html): Empties the Google Drive trash folder, permanently deleting all trashed files.
- [EACloseFiscalPeriodsInRange](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACloseFiscalPeriodsInRange.html): Automatically closes fiscal periods that have passed their end dates.
- [EACodeValidator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACodeValidator.html): Validates entity code fields against formatting rules including length limits, prefixes/suffixes, and regex patterns.
- [EACopyEmptyAccountsFromBag](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACopyEmptyAccountsFromBag.html): Copies subsidiary account assignments from account bag to fill empty subsidiary account fields.
- [EADeleteFromAnotherServer](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteFromAnotherServer.html): Deletes entities from remote Nama ERP servers through web services to maintain data synchronization across multi-server environments.
- [EADeleteFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteFromQuery.html): Executes SQL query to find entities, then deletes all returned entities.
- [EADeleteOldFiles](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteOldFiles.html): Manages file system cleanup by keeping only a specified number of recent files in folders, deleting older files to maintain storage efficiency.
- [EADetailsRemover](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADetailsRemover.html): Removes specific lines from document detail collections based on query conditions or predefined criteria for selective cleanup of detail records.
- [EADownloadURLsIntoAttachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADownloadURLsIntoAttachments.html): Downloads the file at each URL field value into the matching attachment field, setting the file name on the stored file.
- [EAEmptifyTomcatTemp](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAEmptifyTomcatTemp.html): Cleans Tomcat temp directory by removing old files and folders while preserving recent items to manage server storage and improve performance.
- [EAErrorIfQueryNotMatched](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAErrorIfQueryNotMatched.html): Validates entity data using SQL query and displays custom error message if validation fails.
- [EAExecuteUpdateQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExecuteUpdateQuery.html): Executes custom SQL UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE statements directly against the database for bulk operations and data modifications with optional cache eviction.
- [EAExecuteUpdateQueryOnDifferentDatasource](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExecuteUpdateQueryOnDifferentDatasource.html): Executes SQL UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE statements on external databases using configured data sources for cross-database operations and system integration.
- [EAExportAttachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExportAttachments.html): Exports file attachments from entity attachment fields to server file system with flexible naming and organization options.
- [EAFieldsValuesCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAFieldsValuesCalculator.html): Please review the page at Field Values Calculator
- [EAForceApplyInstallmentEffects](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAForceApplyInstallmentEffects.html): Recalculates and updates installment payment tracking for documents with installment-based payments, synchronizing paid amounts and remaining balances.
- [EAForceUsersToChangePassword](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAForceUsersToChangePassword.html): Flags users to be required to change their password on their next login when their last password change is older than a configurable number of days (default: 45).

### Accounting Module

- [Accounting Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/)
- [EAAddAccountingEffect](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAAddAccountingEffect.html): This entity flow adds extra accounting effects (journal entries) to documents that already have existing ledger transactions.
- [EAClearLedgerLines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAClearLedgerLines.html): Automatically removes all ledger transaction lines and debt entries from accounting requests during the pre-processing phase.
- [EAGenInvestmentDocClaimingDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAGenInvestmentDocClaimingDoc.html): Automatically generates Investment Document Claiming records for treasury bonds that reach their maturity date today.
- [EAGenJournalEntry](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAGenJournalEntry.html): Automatically creates journal entries (accounting vouchers) from any document in the system, enabling automatic posting of accounting effects to the ledger.
- [EAGenTreasuryBillCloseDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAGenTreasuryBillCloseDoc.html): Automatically generates Treasury Bill Close Documents for treasury bills that have reached their due date and are still in "Running" status.
- [EARVPVControlJournal](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EARVPVControlJournal.html): Automatically generates control journal entries for Receipt and Payment Vouchers (RVPV) when they have a related subsidiary account.
- [EAReverseLedgerTrans](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAReverseLedgerTrans.html): Reverses previously created accounting transactions by creating opposite entries.
- [EAShortenLedger](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAShortenLedger.html): Consolidates duplicate ledger transaction lines by combining multiple lines with identical characteristics into single lines with net debit/credit amounts.
- [EAShortenLedgerChangeToAccountCurrency](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAShortenLedgerChangeToAccountCurrency.html): Ensures ledger transaction lines use the same currency as their associated accounts.
- [EASortLedger](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EASortLedger.html): Automatically sorts ledger transaction lines in a specific order before they are sent to the accounting system.

- [EAEmbedRecordsFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/ai/EAEmbedRecordsFromQuery.html): Description: This entity flow processes database records to create AI embeddings (vector representations) for search and AI-powered features.
- [EAKeepZillizClusterActive](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/ai/EAKeepZillizClusterActive.html): Executes a lightweight query on the configured Zilliz (Milvus) vector database to prevent the cluster from being suspended due to inactivity.

- [EAMakeSingleCheckInCheckOutIfNeeded](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EAMakeSingleCheckInCheckOutIfNeeded.html): Converts incomplete attendance records from check-in only to check-out only when the recorded time falls within a specified range.
- [EAOyoonWorkPlaceUpdateToUpdateInfo](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EAOyoonWorkPlaceUpdateToUpdateInfo.html): Automatically generates or updates employee information update documents when workplace changes are committed or deleted.
- [EASalaryCostCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EASalaryCostCalculator.html): Calculates the gross salary required to achieve a specific net salary amount, considering taxes and insurance deductions.
- [EASalaryNormalizeAdditions](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EASalaryNormalizeAdditions.html): Adjusts salary components when total deductions exceed additions, preventing negative net salary situations.
- [EASalaryNormalizeDeductions](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EASalaryNormalizeDeductions.html): Adjusts salary components when total additions exceed deductions, ensuring balanced salary calculations.
- [EATimeAttendanceFromDBImportIntoDocument](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EATimeAttendanceFromDBImportIntoDocument.html): Imports time attendance data from external databases directly into the current time attendance document.
- [EATimeAttendanceFromDBImporter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EATimeAttendanceFromDBImporter.html): Creates or updates time attendance documents by importing data from external databases.
- [EATimeAttendanceSetDefaultFromTime](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EATimeAttendanceSetDefaultFromTime.html): Automatically sets punch-in (from) times for time attendance records that have missing start times.
- [EATimeAttendanceSetDefaultToTime](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EATimeAttendanceSetDefaultToTime.html): Automatically sets punch-out (to) times for time attendance records that have missing end times.
- [EAUpdateEmployeeResidencyRenewDate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EAUpdateEmployeeResidencyRenewDate.html): Updates employee residency renewal dates based on residence renewal documents.
- [SetAttendanceToFixedTimeIfEmpty](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/SetAttendanceToFixedTimeIfEmpty.html): Fills missing time values in attendance records with default fixed times.
- [TimeAttendanceAddExtraHoursToEmpty](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/TimeAttendanceAddExtraHoursToEmpty.html): Fills missing attendance times based on employee work schedules with optional hour adjustments.
- [TimeAttendanceRemoveEmptyTimeLines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/TimeAttendanceRemoveEmptyTimeLines.html): Removes attendance lines that have no time information.

### e-commerce Integration Module

- [e-commerce Integration Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/)
- [EAEcommerceAddItemToLinker](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceAddItemToLinker.html): Adds inventory items to Magento e-commerce integration linkers.
- [EAEcommerceGuessItemBySKU](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceGuessItemBySKU.html): Automatically resolves inventory items in sales documents using SKU lookups from Magento integration.
- [EAEcommerceReadAbandonedCarts](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceReadAbandonedCarts.html): Retrieves abandoned shopping cart data from Magento e-commerce sites.
- [EAEcommerceReadOrders](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceReadOrders.html): Retrieves specific order data from Magento e-commerce sites using order IDs.
- [EAEcommerceReadOrdersFromDate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceReadOrdersFromDate.html): Retrieves orders from Magento e-commerce sites based on a date range calculated from the current date.
- [EAEcommerceReadReturns](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceReadReturns.html): Reads return orders (credit memos / RMAs) from an e-commerce site — Magento, Amazon or any other configured site reader — and imports them into the ERP as sales returns.
- [EAEcommerceShippingHandler](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceShippingHandler.html): Handles e-commerce shipping operations for supply chain documents through configured shipping sites.
- [EAEcommerceUploadQuantityCSVFileToFTPServer](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EAEcommerceUploadQuantityCSVFileToFTPServer.html): Exports SKU and quantity data from Magento sites to CSV files and uploads them to FTP/SFTP servers.
- [EASalesRecalculateFreeAndRelatedItems](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/magento/EASalesRecalculateFreeAndRelatedItems.html): Recalculates sales documents by updating unit prices, discounts, and free/related item promotions.

### Manufacturing Module

- [EAStartOrderIfNotStarted](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/manufacturing/EAStartOrderIfNotStarted.html): Automatically starts production orders that are still in initial status by changing their status to "In Progress".

### POS Module

- [POS Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/namapos/)
- [EADarTibaServiceInvoiceTermSetter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/namapos/EADarTibaServiceInvoiceTermSetter.html): Sets payment terms on POS sales documents, but only when all items in the document are service items.
- [EADeleteOldPOSOnlineOrderEntries](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/namapos/EADeleteOldPOSOnlineOrderEntries.html): Deletes old POS online order entries that have exceeded a specified age in hours.

### Real Estate Module

- [EAAutoExtendExpiredRentContracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/realestate/EAAutoExtendExpiredRentContracts.html): Automatically creates new rent contracts by extending expired contracts.
- [EAAutoGenerateREFineDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/realestate/EAAutoGenerateREFineDoc.html): Automatically generates fine documents for overdue real estate payments.
- [EACancelReservationOFSalesInitialDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/realestate/EACancelReservationOFSalesInitialDoc.html): Cancels estate reservations for initial sales contracts by setting the reserveEstate flag to false.
- [EAFixNextAndPreviousFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/realestate/EAFixNextAndPreviousFromQuery.html): Repairs and updates the chain linkages between consecutive rent contracts by fixing previous/next contract references.

### Service Center Module

- [Service Center Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/srvcenter/)
- [EACopyMotorAndChassisSerialsAndLotsToAssembledItemInCoProds](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/srvcenter/EACopyMotorAndChassisSerialsAndLotsToAssembledItemInCoProds.html): Copies engine and chassis serial numbers and lot information from assembly document component lines to their corresponding co-product lines.
- [EARecalculateSrvcOperationsAndMaterialsPrices](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/srvcenter/EARecalculateSrvcOperationsAndMaterialsPrices.html): Recalculates pricing for service operations and materials on service center jobs by updating unit prices, hourly rates, and total prices based on current pricing configurations.
- [EARecalculateSrvcOperationsAndMaterialsPricesFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/srvcenter/EARecalculateSrvcOperationsAndMaterialsPricesFromQuery.html): Bulk recalculates pricing for service operations and materials on multiple service center jobs using a custom SQL query to identify target jobs.
- [EASRVCCopyExecutionRemarksToJobOrder](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/srvcenter/EASRVCCopyExecutionRemarksToJobOrder.html): Copies execution remarks from production execution task lines to the corresponding job order task lines.
- [EAUpdateAssemblyDocWithAssembledItemSold](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/srvcenter/EAUpdateAssemblyDocWithAssembledItemSold.html): Automatically updates assembly documents when assembled items are sold by managing co-product quantities and serial numbers.
- [EAUseReceiptPaperForEngineOrChassisItems](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/srvcenter/EAUseReceiptPaperForEngineOrChassisItems.html): Automatically manages receipt paper allocation for engine or chassis items by matching lot IDs to receipt books and assigning unused receipt papers to document lines.

### Supply Chain Module

- [Supply Chain Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/)
- [EAApplyReservationOfDocsByQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAApplyReservationOfDocsByQuery.html): Applies inventory reservations to supply chain documents identified by a custom SQL query.
- [EAAutoCreateSCDocSecondSerial](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAAutoCreateSCDocSecondSerial.html): Automatically manages second serial number tracking for supply chain documents by maintaining the SCDocSecondSerial table.
- [EAAutoCreateSCDocSerial](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAAutoCreateSCDocSerial.html): Automatically manages primary serial number tracking for supply chain documents by maintaining the SCDocSerial table.
- [EAAutoGenSCDocFromDocWithFieldsMap](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAAutoGenSCDocFromDocWithFieldsMap.html): Automatically generates supply chain documents from other documents using configurable field mapping.
- [EAAutoGroupCloneItemFromPO](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAAutoGroupCloneItemFromPO.html): Converts multi-quantity document lines into individual single-quantity lines by creating separate line entries and unique item codes for each quantity unit.
- [EAAutoSerialNumberCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAAutoSerialNumberCalculator.html): Automatically generates sequential serial numbers for items in supply chain documents based on configurable prefix and number range.
- [EACancelReservationOfDocsByQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACancelReservationOfDocsByQuery.html): Bulk cancels inventory reservations for supply chain documents identified by SQL query.
- [EACollectAlItem](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACollectAlItem.html): Automatically substitutes items in document lines with alternative items from the same category, class, section, or brand when the original item has insufficient stock.
- [EACollectByItemDimension](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACollectByItemDimension.html): Automatically fills empty dimension fields (lot ID, box, or revision ID) in document lines by collecting from available inventory quantities in the ItemDimensionsQty table.
- [EACollectLot](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACollectLot.html): Automatically fills empty dimension fields (lot ID, box, size, color, revision, etc.) in document lines by collecting from available inventory quantities.
- [EACollectStockDocsIfEmpty](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACollectStockDocsIfEmpty.html): Automatically collects and links stock documents into invoices that have stock effects.
- [EACopyItemAssortmentToSCLine](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACopyItemAssortmentToSCLine.html): Automatically copies item assortment information from the item's unit of measure configuration to document lines.
- [EACopyRackCodeFromStockTaking](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACopyRackCodeFromStockTaking.html): Updates item rack location codes in the item master based on rack codes entered during stock taking.
- [EACopyRevisionFromFromDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACopyRevisionFromFromDoc.html): Copies revision ID and pricing information from parent document lines to child document lines.
- [EACopyTaxesFromFromDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACopyTaxesFromFromDoc.html): Copies maximum normal tax percentages (Tax1-Tax4) from parent invoice lines to child invoice lines.
- [EACopyUnitCostFromInvoiceToIssueDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EACopyUnitCostFromInvoiceToIssueDoc.html): Copies unit prices from related invoice lines to issue document lines as unit costs.
- [EAEGBRASSFixCreationDates](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAEGBRASSFixCreationDates.html): Bulk fixes creation dates on supply chain documents identified by SQL query.
- [EAFillSCDetailsByBarCodeSpecs](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAFillSCDetailsByBarCodeSpecs.html): Parses barcode information from item codes and automatically fills document line details with item references and extracted properties.
- [EAGenAndItemSizesAndColorsAndRevisions](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAGenAndItemSizesAndColorsAndRevisions.html): Automatically creates missing size, color, and revision master files and adds them to item configurations based on document line dimensions.
- [EAGenSCDocFromDocWithFieldsMap](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAGenSCDocFromDocWithFieldsMap.html): Generates supply chain documents from other documents using configurable field mapping and line filtering.
- [EAGenSCDocFromDocWithFieldsMapWithoutFlush](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAGenSCDocFromDocWithFieldsMapWithoutFlush.html): Generates supply chain documents from other documents using configurable field mapping and line filtering, but without automatic database flushing during the process.
- [EAGuessSourceLineByItemIdAndFreeItem](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAGuessSourceLineByItemIdAndFreeItem.html): Automatically matches document lines to their corresponding source lines when the normal origin/from document relationships are missing or broken.
- [EAGuessSourceLineIdByItem](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAGuessSourceLineIdByItem.html): Automatically establishes document line relationships by matching lines to their corresponding source lines when normal origin/from document links are missing or broken.
- [EAImportItemsFromLongTextField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAImportItemsFromLongTextField.html): Imports items into a supply chain document by parsing item codes from a long text field.
- [EALotCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EALotCalculator.html): ⚠️ INCOMPLETE IMPLEMENTATION - This entity flow is currently a stub implementation that performs no actual operations.
- [EAMultiCustomerSalesOfferCreator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAMultiCustomerSalesOfferCreator.html): Creates individual sales quotations for multiple customers from a single sales order that contains lines for different customers.
- [EANotifyIfSSLCertificateAboutToExpire](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EANotifyIfSSLCertificateAboutToExpire.html): Monitors SSL certificate expiration dates for specified websites and sends email notifications when certificates are about to expire.
- [EAPreventChangingSCDocumentCriticalFields](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAPreventChangingSCDocumentCriticalFields.html): Enforces data integrity by preventing modifications to critical fields in supply chain document lines after the document has been committed for the first time.
- [EAPreventQtyLessThan](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAPreventQtyLessThan.html): Validates that document line quantities meet minimum quantity requirements by comparing actual quantities against configurable minimum limits.
- [EAPreventQtyMoreThan](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAPreventQtyMoreThan.html): Validates that document line quantities do not exceed maximum quantity limits by comparing actual quantities against configurable maximum thresholds.
- [EAPreventRepeatedItems](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAPreventRepeatedItems.html): Validates supply chain documents to prevent duplicate items in document lines based on configurable criteria.
- [EAPreventRepeatedValuesAtDetail](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAPreventRepeatedValuesAtDetail.html): Validates document detail collections to prevent duplicate values in specified fields across detail lines.
- [EAReApplyQtyTrackingEffects](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAReApplyQtyTrackingEffects.html): Recalculates and reapplies quantity tracking effects for supply chain documents by treating the document as if it were being inserted for the first time.
- [EARecalcFreeLinesUnitPriceIfZero](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARecalcFreeLinesUnitPriceIfZero.html): Recalculates unit prices for free lines in sales documents when their unit price is zero or empty.
- [EARecalcPurchasePrices](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARecalcPurchasePrices.html): Recalculates purchase prices for all lines in purchase documents by temporarily enabling price updates and triggering the standard purchase price recalculation logic.
- [EARecalcSalesDocDiscounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARecalcSalesDocDiscounts.html): Recalculates discount amounts and percentages for all lines in sales documents without changing unit prices.
- [EARecalcSalesDocUnitPrices](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARecalcSalesDocUnitPrices.html): Recalculates unit prices for all lines in sales documents without changing discount calculations.
- [EARecalcSalesDocUnitPricesAndDiscounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARecalcSalesDocUnitPricesAndDiscounts.html): Performs complete recalculation of both unit prices and discount calculations for all lines in sales documents.
- [EARecalculateAdditionalCost](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARecalculateAdditionalCost.html): Recalculates additional costs and expense item lines for assembly documents by triggering the standard expense calculation logic.
- [EARegenAssemblyDocumentDetailsFromBOM](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARegenAssemblyDocumentDetailsFromBOM.html): Regenerates assembly document lines from the Bill of Materials (BOM) by replacing existing document lines with fresh component lines based on the current BOM structure.
- [EARegenInvTransReq](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARegenInvTransReq.html): Regenerates and processes inventory transaction requests for supply chain documents by creating fresh inventory transaction requests and sending them through the business request system.
- [EARegenInvTransReqFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EARegenInvTransReqFromQuery.html): Bulk regenerates inventory transaction requests for multiple supply chain documents identified by SQL query.
- [EAReplaceItemBoxInSystem](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAReplaceItemBoxInSystem.html): Performs system-wide replacement of item box values across all supply chain document tables.
- [EAReplaceItemColorInSystem](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAReplaceItemColorInSystem.html): Performs system-wide replacement of item color values across all supply chain document tables.
- [EAReplaceItemSizeInSystem](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAReplaceItemSizeInSystem.html): Performs system-wide replacement of item size values across all supply chain document tables.
- [EASCDocFromDocCreator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASCDocFromDocCreator.html): Creates a new supply chain document from an existing document by copying header information and all document lines.
- [EASCDocFromDocDeleter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASCDocFromDocDeleter.html): Deletes supply chain documents that are referenced in specified fields of the source document.
- [EASCPreventChangingFromDocFields](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASCPreventChangingFromDocFields.html): Enforces data integrity by preventing unauthorized changes to specified fields when comparing supply chain documents with their source documents (fromDoc).
- [EASalesRecalculateFreeAndRelatedItems](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASalesRecalculateFreeAndRelatedItems.html): Recalculates pricing information for sales documents including unit prices, discounts, free items, and related items.
- [EASendCustomerToDatanuum](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASendCustomerToDatanuum.html): Synchronizes customer information with the Datanuum external service for reward points and loyalty program integration.
- [EASendInvItemToDatanuum](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASendInvItemToDatanuum.html): Synchronizes inventory item information with the Datanuum external service for reward points and loyalty program integration.
- [EASendInvoiceToDatanuum](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASendInvoiceToDatanuum.html): Synchronizes sales invoice/receipt information with the Datanuum external service for reward points and loyalty program integration.
- [EASendReturnedInvoiceToDatanuum](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASendReturnedInvoiceToDatanuum.html): Synchronizes sales return/credit memo information with the Datanuum external service for reward points and loyalty program integration.
- [EASetDefaultWarehouseForServiceItems](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASetDefaultWarehouseForServiceItems.html): Automatically assigns a default warehouse to service items in supply chain documents that don't already have a warehouse specified.
- [EASpreadAssemblyComponents](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASpreadAssemblyComponents.html): Expands assembly items in supply chain documents by spreading their Bill of Materials (BOM) components.
- [EASubolSetMasterRowIdOfFreeItems](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASubolSetMasterRowIdOfFreeItems.html): Establishes relationships between free items and their associated master items in sales documents.
- [EASupplyChainMergeDocLines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASupplyChainMergeDocLines.html): Consolidates multiple document lines containing the same item into single lines by merging quantities and combining similar items.
- [EASupplyChainMergeStockTakingElectronicDocLines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EASupplyChainMergeStockTakingElectronicDocLines.html): Consolidates duplicate lines in electronic stock taking documents by merging lines with identical properties (item code, date, lot, serial numbers, etc.) and combining their quantities.
- [EAUnZipSerialsInLines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUnZipSerialsInLines.html): Expands document lines containing multiple serial numbers into individual lines with one serial number each.
- [EAUniCreteGenAssemblyBOM](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUniCreteGenAssemblyBOM.html): Generates assembly Bill of Materials (BOMs) for items based on partial BOM templates and item class matching.
- [EAUniCreteGenItems](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUniCreteGenItems.html): Generates inventory items automatically based on item class hierarchies and relationships.
- [EAUniCreteGenSalesInvoiceFromStockIssue](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUniCreteGenSalesInvoiceFromStockIssue.html): Creates sales documents (typically invoices) from stock issue documents by tracing back to the original parent documents (like sales orders).
- [EAUniCreteSetQtyOfSlaveRowsAsMaster](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUniCreteSetQtyOfSlaveRowsAsMaster.html): Synchronizes quantities of slave (dependent) document lines with their corresponding master lines.
- [EAUnicreteGenItemsAllAllowMustApply](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUnicreteGenItemsAllAllowMustApply.html): Enhanced version of the item generation process with stricter allow rule enforcement.
- [EAUpdateDeliveryStatusFromSalesDocToFromDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUpdateDeliveryStatusFromSalesDocToFromDoc.html): Updates delivery status information in parent sales documents based on changes in the current document.
- [EAUpdateLotIdDates](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUpdateLotIdDates.html): Updates lot date information (expiry, production, retest dates) across all system tables based on the dates specified in document lines.
- [SetQuantityToOneAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/SetQuantityToOneAction.html): Sets default quantity values to 1 for document lines that have zero or empty quantities.
- [SetSecondUOMToDefaultIfEmpty](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/SetSecondUOMToDefaultIfEmpty.html): Automatically assigns the default secondary unit of measure to document lines when the secondary UOM field is empty.
- [UniqueBOXInsideStockReceipt](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/UniqueBOXInsideStockReceipt.html): Validates that each box number is used only once per item within a stock receipt document.
- [ValidateSorceLinesOfFromDocAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/ValidateSorceLinesOfFromDocAction.html): Validates that all lines in the current document have corresponding source lines in the parent document when the document is based on another document (fromDoc relationship).

- [Inventory Costing Methods - Video 2](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/cost-video-2.html): A comprehensive and detailed explanation of inventory cost calculation systems and the impact of supply operations, purchase returns, and taxes on them in business and warehouse environments.
